## Process scRNA-seq data

Launch [scRNA.nf](https://github.com/landau-lab/smartpta#scrnaseq-analysis-scrnanf)
Then follow the notebook under scripts/rna named `rso-scvi-2026.ipynb`

## Run SingleCheck on scDNA-seq data

Follow instructions [here](https://github.com/tamaraprieto/SingleCheck)

## Run variant calling on scDNA-seq data 

Launch [scVC.nf](https://github.com/landau-lab/smartpta#scvariantcalling-scvcnf)
 
## Obtain germline and somatic variants

```{bash }

donor=cu01 
tag=full
sex=female

# Run sequoia modification by intervals and then combine them
# uses ${SCRIPTSDIR}/sequoia/sequoia_filters_germline.R
# vcf path is harcoded, it should be replaced
num_intervals=4013 
myjob=$(sbatch --array=1-${num_intervals}%200 --dependency=afterok:${myjob}  \
  ${SCRIPTSDIR}/sequoia/eso.rso.sequoia.interval.sh $donor $tag 4000 $sex | awk '{print $4}')
myjob=$(sbatch --dependency=afterok:$myjob \
  ${SCRIPTSDIR}/sequoia/eso.rso.sequoia.interval.combine.sh \
  $donor $tag $num_intervals | awk '{print $4}')

# Normalize variants 
sbatch --dependency=afterok:$myjob ${SCRIPTSDIR}/NormalizeVariants.sh $donor $tag

# Create a set of somatic mutations shared across donors (only once across donors)
sbatch ${SCRIPTSDIR}/IntersectVariants.sh

# Separate somatic mutations
sbatch ${SCRIPTSDIR}/Somatic.sh $donor $tag

# Separate germline variants
sbatch ${SCRIPTSDIR}/Germline.sh $donor $tag

```

## Create metadata objects

```{r }

rna_dir=paste0(input_figs, "RNA/")
rna_types <- paste0(rna_dir,"rso_04_08_2026_obs.csv")
rna_umap <- paste0(rna_dir,"rso_04_08_2026_umap.csv")


CreateRDSWithMetadataPerPatient  <- function(patient){  
    
   # index sorting
    immune <-  read.table (file =  paste0(input_figs, "/immune.",patient,".txt")) %>% unlist() %>% as.vector()

    phenotypes_rna_raw <- data.table::fread(rna_types) %>%
        left_join(data.table::fread(rna_umap) %>% dplyr::rename(`UMAP 1`="V2",`UMAP 2`="V3")) %>%
        dplyr::rename(`sample name`=V1) %>%
        dplyr::filter(sample==patient) %>%
        dplyr::filter(!is.na(`sample name`)) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(cell_type=factor(as.factor(cell_type),
                                       levels=c("Basal Epithelial", 
                                                "Proliferative Basal Epithelial",
                                                "Suprabasal Epithelial",
                                                "Terminally Differentiated Epithelial", 
                                                "CD4+ T Cell","CD8+ T Cell","Macrophage","Mast Cell"))) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(sorting=ifelse(`sample name` %in% immune, "CD45+","EpCAM+"))


    # REGIONS
    cells_with_DNA_regions <- readRDS(file =  paste0(input_figs,"cellswithdna.regions.rds"))
    cell_location <- cells_with_DNA_regions %>%
      dplyr::rename(`sample name`=cell) %>%
      dplyr::filter(donor %in% patient) %>%
      unique() 
    
    phenotypes_rna_raw <- phenotypes_rna_raw %>%
      dplyr::select(-`cm.from.mouth`,-region) %>%
      dplyr::full_join(cell_location)
      
    # SINGLECHECK
    qc_highdepth <- fread("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vTRE5hP8_2xk3TceUsJsiRZl9ZIXtdGC0oozMsXhHttU5_bJdgzoTN1M7VjIqrluLf4TOx-m-XcIlps/pub?gid=655321588&single=true&output=csv") %>%
      full_join(fread("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vTRE5hP8_2xk3TceUsJsiRZl9ZIXtdGC0oozMsXhHttU5_bJdgzoTN1M7VjIqrluLf4TOx-m-XcIlps/pub?gid=613779293&single=true&output=tsv")) %>%
      dplyr::rename(`sample name`=Sample) %>%
      dplyr::filter(grepl(patient,`sample name`)) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(`sample name`=gsub(".dedup","",`sample name`))
    
     phenotypes_rna_raw <- phenotypes_rna_raw %>%
      dplyr::left_join(qc_highdepth)
  
    # GENE EXPRESSION
     rna.gene.matrix <- data.table::fread(cmd = paste0('zcat ',input_figs,'RNA/rso_04_08_2026_mtx.csv.gz'))

    # add underscores to the gene names 
    colnames(rna.gene.matrix) <- paste0("_",colnames(rna.gene.matrix),"_")
    rna.gene.matrix <- rna.gene.matrix  %>%
         dplyr::rename(`sample name`="_V1_")

    
    phenotypes_rna_and_variablemarkers <- phenotypes_rna_raw %>%
      left_join(rna.gene.matrix)
    phenotypes_rna_and_variablemarkers[1:10,1:1000]
    length(colnames(phenotypes_rna_and_variablemarkers))
    
   # write down RNA information
   saveRDS(phenotypes_rna_raw,paste0(input_figs, "/phenotypes_rna_raw.",patient,".rds"))
    
   # write down RNA information plus gene expression
   saveRDS(phenotypes_rna_and_variablemarkers,
           paste0(input_figs,"phenotypes_rna_plusgeneexpression.",patient,".rds"))

}

lapply(X = c("eso29","cu01","cu02","cu03","cu08"),CreateRDSWithMetadataPerPatient)

```

## Calculate average VAFs across genomic bins (phased input)

```{r }

library(GenomicRanges)

donor_database <- fread(paste0(input_figs,"donor.metadata.txt"))

phased_vafs <- function(patient,mychrom, binsize="50kb"){

  print(mychrom)
  patient_sex <- donor_database %>%
    dplyr::filter(V1==patient) %>%
    dplyr::select(V3) %>% unlist() %>% as.character()
  
              if (mychrom=="chrX" & patient_sex=="M") {
              mytable_shapeit <- data.table::fread(paste0(main_dir,patient,"/manual_collate/sequoia/phasing/",patient,"_",mychrom,".shapeit5.",mychrom,".table"),dec = ".") %>%
                  dplyr::filter(Mean_Depth>3)
              } else {
              # Load the phased phased germline SNPs & remove non-heterozygous sites
              mytable_shapeit <- data.table::fread(paste0(main_dir,patient,"/manual_collate/sequoia/phasing/",patient,"_",mychrom,".shapeit5.",mychrom,".table"),dec = ".") %>%
                dplyr::filter(AF>0.3 & AF<0.7 & Mean_Depth>3)
              }
                dim(mytable_shapeit)
                # obtain VAF
              myvafs <- mytable_shapeit %>%
                dplyr::select(colnames(mytable_shapeit)[grepl(".VAF", colnames(mytable_shapeit))]) %>% as.data.frame()
              # obtain Phased GT
              myphased_gts <- mytable_shapeit %>%
                dplyr::select(colnames(mytable_shapeit)[grepl(".PhasedGT", colnames(mytable_shapeit))]) %>% as.data.frame()
              # obtain DP
              myphased_dps <- mytable_shapeit %>%
                dplyr::select(colnames(mytable_shapeit)[grepl(".DP", colnames(mytable_shapeit))]) %>% as.data.frame()
              # Set up as NAs all VAFs supported by 3 reads or less 
              myphased_gts[myphased_dps<=3] <- NA
              myphased_gts[myphased_dps>30] <- NA
              myphased_gts[is.na(myphased_gts)] <- ".|."
              myphased_gts2 <- myphased_gts
              # swap VAF depending on phasing
              rev_vafs <- 1-myvafs %>% as.data.frame()
              myphased_gts2[myphased_gts == "1|0"] <- myvafs[myphased_gts == "1|0"]
              myphased_gts2[myphased_gts == "1|0"] <- rev_vafs[myphased_gts == "1|0"]
              myphased_gts2[myphased_gts != "1|0" & myphased_gts != ".|."] <- myvafs[myphased_gts != "1|0" & myphased_gts != ".|."]
              myphased_gts2[myphased_gts == ".|."] <- NA
              myphased_gts2 <- apply(myphased_gts2, 2, as.numeric)
              rownames(myphased_gts2) <- mytable_shapeit$POS
              myphased_gts2 <- myphased_gts2[!is.na(rowMeans(myphased_gts2, na.rm = T)),]
              # Average the values across intervals from ginkgo 
              # Convert rownames of A to numeric
              end_A <- as.numeric(rownames(myphased_gts2))
              # Create a GRanges object for A using END positions as the same start and end
              gr_A <- GRanges(
                seqnames = mychrom,  # Assuming one chromosome
                ranges = IRanges(start = end_A, end = end_A),
                mcols = myphased_gts2
              )
              cnv_absolute <- data.table::fread(paste0(GINKGODIR, patient, "_hg38_", binsize, "/SegCopy")) %>%
        dplyr::filter(CHR==mychrom)
              # Create a GRanges object for B using START and END columns
              gr_B <- GRanges(
                seqnames = cnv_absolute$CHR,  # Assuming one chromosome
                ranges = IRanges(start = cnv_absolute$START, end = cnv_absolute$END)
              )
              # Find overlaps between intervals
              overlaps <- findOverlaps(gr_B, gr_A)
              # Convert to a data.table for speed
              overlap_dt <- data.table(
                B_idx = queryHits(overlaps),  # Indices of B
                A_idx = subjectHits(overlaps) # Indices of A
              )
            # Add values from A to overlap_dt
            overlap_dt <- cbind(overlap_dt, as.data.table(mcols(gr_A))[overlap_dt$A_idx, ])
            # Get numeric columns again AFTER cbind()
            value_cols <- colnames(overlap_dt)[sapply(overlap_dt, is.numeric) & !(colnames(overlap_dt) %in% c("B_idx", "A_idx"))]
            # Calculate means for each interval in B
            avg_dt <- overlap_dt[, lapply(.SD, mean, na.rm = TRUE), by = B_idx, .SDcols = value_cols]
            # Add START and END from B to the result
            result_dt <- cbind(cnv_absolute[avg_dt$B_idx, c("CHR","START", "END")], avg_dt[, -1, with = FALSE])
            # Convert to a data frame if needed
            phased_vafs_averaged <- as.data.frame(result_dt)
            colnames(phased_vafs_averaged) <- gsub(".PhasedGT","",gsub("mcols.","",colnames(phased_vafs_averaged)))
    return(phased_vafs_averaged)
} 


mypatient="eso29"
mybinsize="500kb"
phasing_VAFs <- do.call("rbind",lapply(paste0("chr", c(1:22,"X")), phased_vafs, patient=mypatient, binsize=mybinsize))
saveRDS(phasing_VAFs, paste0(main_dir,mypatient,"/manual_collate/sequoia/phasing/", mybinsize,".combinedphasing.rds"))
```

```{r}

table_allelicimbalance <- function(patient, binsize) {

    print(patient)
    mytree <- readRDS(paste0(input_figs,"phylogeny.",patient,".RDS")) 
    if (patient=="cu02") {
        mytree <- treeio::drop.tip(mytree,"cu02_p1r4M10")
    }
       
    # UNPHASED VAF (absolute value - 0.5) : 
    cnv_vaf <- fread(paste0(main_dir,
                            patient, "/manual_collate/sequoia/cnv/", 
                            binsize,  "_avg.vaf.concat.csv")) %>%
      as.data.frame()
    cnv_vaf <- cnv_vaf[,c("CHR", "START","END",mytree@phylo$tip.label)] 
     dim(cnv_vaf)
  
    # ABSOLUT COPY NUMBER
      rdr_anno <- fread(paste0(GINKGODIR, 
                               patient, "_hg38_", binsize, "/SegCopy"))  %>% 
              as.data.frame()
      
      rdr_anno2 <- rdr_anno[,c("CHR", "START","END",mytree@phylo$tip.label)] %>%
              dplyr::select(!1:3) %>%  
              t()
      colnames(rdr_anno2) <- apply(rdr_anno[,1:3], 1, function(x) paste(trimws(x), collapse = "_")) 
      rdr_simplified_anno <- matrixStats::rowMedians(rdr_anno2) %>% cbind() 
      colnames(rdr_simplified_anno) <- "median CNV\n in gene"
      
    # PHASED VAF
    # Add code about phased VAFs
    cnv_vaf_phased<- readRDS(paste0(main_dir,patient,"/manual_collate/sequoia/phasing/", binsize,".combinedphasing.rds"))
    cnv_vaf_phased <- cnv_vaf_phased[,c("CHR", "START","END",mytree@phylo$tip.label)] 
    dim(cnv_vaf_phased)
     
    out <- list(AI_unphased=cnv_vaf,
                 AI_phased=cnv_vaf_phased,
                 CNV=rdr_anno,
                 CNV_string=rdr_simplified_anno)
     print("Output generated")
     return(out)
}
      
```

```{r}
##somatic classification based on linked-reads 
fpr_summary <- function(patient){
  print(patient)
  fpr_table <- data.table::fread(paste0(main_dir,
                                        patient,"/manual_collate/sequoia/fpr/",patient,
                                        ".FP.TP.all.txt"),
                               fill=TRUE) %>%
                dplyr::mutate(sompos=as.integer(gsub(".*:","",`chr:var`))) %>%
                dplyr::mutate(distance=abs(sompos-hetSNP)) %>%
                dplyr::group_by(`chr:var`,cell) %>%
                dplyr::mutate(smallerdist=min(distance)) %>%
                dplyr::ungroup() %>%
                dplyr::mutate(site=ifelse(smallerdist==distance, "closest","distant")) %>%
                dplyr::filter(site=="closest") %>%
                dplyr::filter(smallerdist==distance) %>%  # select the closest variant to the SNP
                dplyr::rowwise() %>%
                dplyr::mutate(matching_reads=sum(REF_ALT,REF_REF,ALT_REF,ALT_ALT)) %>%  # 
                dplyr::filter(matching_reads>8) %>%
                dplyr::mutate(a=ifelse(REF_ALT>0, 1,0)) %>%
                dplyr::mutate(b=ifelse(REF_REF>0, 1,0)) %>%
                dplyr::mutate(c=ifelse(ALT_REF>0,1,0)) %>%
                dplyr::mutate(d=ifelse(ALT_ALT>0,1,0)) %>%
                dplyr::rowwise() %>%
                dplyr::mutate(num_categories=sum(a,b,c,d)) %>%
                dplyr::mutate(class=ifelse(num_categories==2,"tp","fp")) %>%
                # If there is only one read supporting a third haplotype consider it TP yet in this first classification
                dplyr::mutate(class=ifelse(num_categories==3 & 
                                             (REF_ALT==1 | REF_REF==1 | ALT_REF==1 | ALT_ALT==1),"tp",class)) %>%
                dplyr::mutate(class=ifelse(num_categories!=1, class, "Less than 1 haplotype"))
  
  # Write down file for annotation
  fpr_table_annotated <- fpr_table %>% 
    dplyr::select(c(`chr:var`, hetSNP,cell, class,num_categories,
                                matching_reads,nonmatching_reads,
                    colnames(fpr_table)[grepl("_",colnames(fpr_table))])) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = colnames(fpr_table)[grepl("(R|E|F|A|L|T)_(R|E|F|A|L|T)",colnames(fpr_table))]) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(`chr:var`,hetSNP,cell) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(shanon_diversity=vegan::diversity(value)) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(-value,-name) %>%
    unique() %>%
    dplyr::group_by(`chr:var`) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(num_cells=n()) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(tp_count=ifelse(class=="tp",1,0), fp_count=ifelse(class=="fp",1,0)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(`chr:var`) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(total_tp=sum(tp_count),total_fp=sum(fp_count)) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(ratio_tp=total_tp/num_cells) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(ratio_fp=total_fp/num_cells) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(class=ifelse(ratio_tp!=1 && ratio_fp!=1, "uncertain",class))
    
  fpr_table_annotated %>%
    dplyr::mutate(class=gsub("tp","Potential\ntrue SNV",gsub("fp","Potential\nerror",class))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=class,y=shanon_diversity)) +
    geom_jitter(aes(col=as.character(num_categories))) +
    geom_boxplot(fill=NA) +
    theme_classic() +
    scale_color_viridis_d() +
    labs(x="Class", y="Shanon diversity index of linked-reads counts\nfor the four possible single-cell haplotypes",
         col="Number of haplotypes\nwith linked-reads support") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust=1), legend.position = "top")
  
  
   fpr_table_annotated %>%
    dplyr::mutate(class=gsub("tp","Potential\ntrue SNV",gsub("fp","Potential\nerror",class))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=shanon_diversity,fill=as.factor(num_categories))) +
    geom_density(alpha=0.5) +
     theme_classic() + labs(x="Shanon diversity of the read counts across the 4 potential haplotypes degined by the biallelic heterozygous germline SNP and the somatic SNV",y="Density,", fill="Number of single-cell haplotypes\nsupported by linked reads") +
     ggsci::scale_fill_aaas() +
     theme(legend.position="top")

   fpr_table_annotated %>%
    dplyr::mutate(class=gsub("tp","Potential\ntrue SNV",gsub("fp","Potential\nerror",class))) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(class)) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x=class,y=shanon_diversity)) +
    geom_jitter(aes(col=ratio_tp)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill=NA) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(x="Class", y="Shanon diversity index of linked-reads counts\nfor the four possible single-cell haplotypes",
         col="Ration TP/FP when found in more than 1 cell") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust=1), legend.position = "top")


   fpr_table_annotated %>%
         dplyr::mutate(chrom=gsub(":.*","",`chr:var`), end=as.numeric(gsub(".*:","",`chr:var`))) %>%
     # I should add 1 to the end coordinate
     dplyr::mutate(end=end+1) %>%
     dplyr::mutate(start=end-1) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(`chr:var`) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(LR_shanon_div_median=median(shanon_diversity),
                  LR_matchingreads_sum=sum(matching_reads),
                  LR_nonmatchingreads_sum=sum(nonmatching_reads),
                  LR_cellstested = paste(cell, collapse = ",")) %>%
     dplyr::ungroup() %>%
     # FURTHER FILTERING
     dplyr::mutate(LR_class_stringent=ifelse((class=="tp" & LR_shanon_div_median>=0.7) | 
                                               (class=="tp" & ratio_tp!=1) | 
                                               (class=="tp" & num_cells<2) | 
                                               (class=="fp" & LR_shanon_div_median<=0.75), 
                                             "uncertain",class)) %>%
    dplyr::select(chrom, start,end,hetSNP, class, LR_class_stringent, LR_shanon_div_median, LR_matchingreads_sum,LR_nonmatchingreads_sum,num_cells,LR_cellstested,ratio_tp,ratio_fp) %>%
    unique() %>%
    dplyr::rename(LR_numcellstested=num_cells, LR_closesthetSNP=hetSNP,LR_ratiotp=ratio_tp,
                  LR_ratiofp=ratio_fp, LR_class=class) %>%
    write.table(paste0(main_dir,
                                        patient,"/manual_collate/sequoia/fpr/linked-reads-annotations.bed"), quote = F, row.names = F, col.names = T, sep = "\t")
 
  # only used for merging, values not considered
  fpr_table2 <- fpr_table_annotated %>%  
    dplyr::filter(class %in% c("fp","tp")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(fp_sum=ifelse(class=="fp", 1,0)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(cell) %>%
    dplyr::summarize(fpr=sum(fp_sum)/n()) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(precision=1-fpr) 

  return(fpr_table2)
}
```

```{r}
# root the phylogeny and recover bootstrap values
best_tree_unrooted <- read.tree(paste0(main_dir,patient,"/manual_collate/cloudCellphy/output/cellphy/support/myselectedvars.CellPhy.raxml.support"))
      
  # ROOTING: root in an immune with unique short branch length
      immune <-  read.table (file =  paste0(input_figs, "/immune.",patient,".txt")) %>% 
        unlist() %>% as.vector()
      myoutgroup <- best_tree_unrooted %>% as_tibble %>% dplyr::filter(label %in% immune) %>% 
        dplyr::arrange(branch.length) %>%
        dplyr::group_by(branch.length) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(n=dplyr::n()) %>%
        dplyr::ungroup() %>%
        dplyr::filter(n==1) %>%
        head(1) %>% 
        dplyr::select(label) %>% 
        unlist() %>% as.character()
      if (patient=="cu08") {
        myoutgroup <- "cu08_p1r4L22"
      }
      best_tree <- ape::root(phy = best_tree_unrooted, outgroup=myoutgroup, resolve.root=T)
      
      branchlength_missing_bootstrap <- best_tree %>% as_tibble() %>%
        dplyr::filter(label=="") %>%
        dplyr::select(branch.length) %>% unlist()
      if (length(branchlength_missing_bootstrap)>1){
        print("Select another cell with unique branch length")
      }
      missing_bootstrap  <- best_tree %>% 
          as_tibble() %>%
          dplyr::filter(branch.length==branchlength_missing_bootstrap) %>% dplyr::select(label) %>% unlist()
      best_tree <- best_tree %>% as_tibble() %>%
        dplyr::mutate(label=ifelse(label=="",missing_bootstrap,label)) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(label=ifelse(parent==node,"",label)) %>%
        ape::as.phylo()

  ape::write.tree(phy = best_tree, file = paste0(main_dir,patient,"/results/CellPhy.",patient,".newick"))
    
      
```

```{r}
                         dplyr::rename(mutmapping_node_postrooting=node,mutmapping_parent_postrooting=parent)) %>%
      dplyr::full_join(calibrated_phylo %>% as_tibble() %>%  dplyr::filter(!grepl(paste0(patient, "_"),label)) %>% dplyr::select(parent,node) %>% 
                         dplyr::rename(calibrated_node_postrooting=node,calibrated_parent_postrooting=parent)) %>%
      dplyr::select(calibrated_parent_postrooting,calibrated_node_postrooting,mutmapping_parent_postrooting,mutmapping_node_postrooting)
    dim(old_new_node_dictionary_internal)
    dim(na.omit(old_new_node_dictionary_internal))
    
    # EXTERNAL NODES
    old_new_node_dictionary_external <- mutmapping_phylo %>% as_tibble() %>% dplyr::filter(grepl(paste0(patient,"_"),label)) %>%
                   dplyr::rename(mutmapping_parent_postrooting=parent, mutmapping_node_postrooting=node) %>%
                   dplyr::left_join( calibrated_phylo %>% as_tibble() %>%

                   dplyr::select(calibrated_parent_postrooting,calibrated_node_postrooting,mutmapping_parent_postrooting,mutmapping_node_postrooting) %>%
                   as.data.frame() %>%
                   dplyr::ungroup()
    dim(old_new_node_dictionary_external)
    # COMBINE EXTERNAL AND INTERNAL
    old_new_node_dictionary <- rbind(old_new_node_dictionary_internal, old_new_node_dictionary_external)
    dim(old_new_node_dictionary)
    
    if ((length(mutmapping_phylo$tip.label)*2-1)!=nrow(old_new_node_dictionary)){
      stop("Rooting of the tree might not be working")
    } else {

    }

    # create a table with node information (before and after mapping)

    key_calibrated<- calibrated_phylo_prerooting %>% as_tibble %>%

      dplyr::select(-label) %>%

    dim(key_calibrated)

      dplyr::select(-label) %>%

dim(all_annotations)

# ANNOTATE ALL SUBBRANCHES WITHIN A CLONE
      # Obtain ID of nodes with mutations
      nodeid_mutation_internal <- all_annotations %>%
        dplyr::filter(ogaini_87genes!="") %>%
        dplyr::filter(mut_count>1) %>%
        dplyr::select(node) %>% unlist() %>% as.vector() %>% as.integer()
      length(nodeid_mutation_internal)
      
      # Obtain subbranches of the nodes with mutations
      subbranches_info <- function(nodeid){
        mysubsampled_tree <- treeio::tree_subset(tree_all_info, node=nodeid, levels_back=0)
        myroot <- castor::find_root(mysubsampled_tree@phylo) 
        out <- mysubsampled_tree %>% as_tibble() %>%
        dplyr::mutate(main_branch=ifelse(parent==node, "root","")) %>%
         dplyr::select(profile.x,main_branch) %>%
          dplyr::mutate(mutated_clone_id=paste0("clone_",nodeid)) 
        return(out)
      }
      subclone_info <- do.call("rbind",lapply(nodeid_mutation_internal, FUN = subbranches_info))
      nodeid_mutation_external <- all_annotations %>%
          dplyr::filter(ogaini_87genes!="") %>%
     dplyr::filter(mut_count==1) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(main_branch="root",mutated_clone_id=paste0("clone_",node)) %>%
        dplyr::select(profile.x,main_branch,mutated_clone_id)
      
      
      mutated_clone_info <- dplyr::full_join(nodeid_mutation_external, subclone_info) %>%
        dplyr::left_join(all_annotations %>% 
                           dplyr::select(profile.x,ogaini_mutations_string,all_mutations_string,nonsynon_mutations_string,synon_mutations_string,dNdS,ogaini_87genes)) %>%
        dplyr::ungroup() %>%
        dplyr::select(-main_branch) %>%
        dplyr::group_by(mutated_clone_id) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(ogaini_87genes=paste0(unique(ogaini_87genes), collapse = " ")) %>%
        dplyr::ungroup() %>%
         dplyr::group_by(profile.x) %>%
        dplyr::summarize(mutated_clone_id=paste0(unique(mutated_clone_id), collapse = " "),
                         profile.x=profile.x,
                  ogaini_mutations_string_collapsed=paste0(unique(ogaini_87genes), collapse = " "),
                         all_mutations_string=all_mutations_string,nonsynon_mutations_string=nonsynon_mutations_string,
                         synon_mutations_string=synon_mutations_string,dNdS=dNdS #, ogaini_87genes=ogaini_87genes
                         ) %>%
        dplyr::ungroup() %>%
        dplyr::mutate(ogaini_mutations_string_collapsed=gsub("^ ","",ogaini_mutations_string_collapsed)) %>%
        unique() 
     dim(mutated_clone_info)
     
        
# CREATE A TABLE FOR ANNOTATING THE TREE  
ogaini_annotation <- all_annotations %>%
        dplyr::left_join(mutated_clone_info) %>%
      # Select columns of interest
      dplyr::select(parent,node,profile.x,
                    ogaini_filtered,ogaini_mutations,ogaini_mutations_string,ogaini_mutations_string_collapsed,
                    all_mutations_string,nonsynon_mutations_string,synon_mutations_string,dNdS,ogaini_87genes,
                    mutated_clone_id) %>%
      unique()
```

```{r}
    unit_LOH_alternative@specific_themes$heatmap$color$max <- "#000000"
    unit_LOH_alternative@specific_themes$heatmap$use_mid <- 0

    # Panel mutations
    unit_panel@profile$name <- "Mutations in the targeted panel"

## add units into hub
    if (patient=="eso29"){
        hub_annotated <- hub + unit_celltypes + unit_celltypes_highres + unit_MAD + 
          unit_depth + unit_breadth + unit_gene_markers + unit_regions +
          unit_LOH_alternative + 
          unit_panel + unit_cellcycle 
       } else if (patient=="cu01") {
       hub_annotated <- hub + unit_celltypes + unit_celltypes_highres  + unit_MAD + 
         unit_depth + unit_breadth + unit_gene_markers + unit_regions + 
         unit_LOH_alternative + 
         unit_panel  + unit_cellcycle  
       } else if (patient=="cu03") {
       hub_annotated <- hub + unit_celltypes + unit_celltypes_highres + unit_MAD + unit_depth + unit_breadth + unit_gene_markers + unit_regions  + unit_cellcycle   
       } else if (patient=="cu08") {
       hub_annotated <- hub + unit_celltypes + unit_celltypes_highres + unit_MAD + unit_depth + unit_breadth + unit_gene_markers + unit_regions  + unit_cellcycle  
       }else {
         hub_annotated <- hub + unit_celltypes + unit_celltypes_highres + unit_MAD + unit_depth + unit_breadth + unit_gene_markers + unit_regions + unit_LOH_alternative + unit_panel  + unit_cellcycle
    }

hub_annotated@theme

## write template file
write_hub(hub_annotated,itol_dir)
```

## Mutation mapping of panel VAFs

```{bash, eval=F}

#Create input for mutation mapping

module load bedtools
# Create a list of all the positions in bed
bedtools makewindows -b ${MAINDIR}/Resources/gene_panel/implemented/Targets-XGEN.87EF358171F54BE7A9133DE926D12A03.chrprefix.merged.bed -w 1 | \
  awk '{print $0}' > ${MAINDIR}/Resources/gene_panel/implemented/Targets-XGEN.87EF358171F54BE7A9133DE926D12A03.chrprefix.merged.allpositions.bed

# Obtain the reference base
bedtools getfasta -fi ${MAINDIR}/Resources/references/hg38/Homo_sapiens_assembly38.fasta -bed ${MAINDIR}/Resources/gene_panel/implemented/Targets-XGEN.87EF358171F54BE7A9133DE926D12A03.chrprefix.merged.allpositions.bed -fo ${MAINDIR}/Resources/gene_panel/implemented/Targets-XGEN.87EF358171F54BE7A9133DE926D12A03.chrprefix.merged.allpositions.fasta -name

# Create all possible mutations taking into account the reference base
awk 'BEGIN{OFS="\t"; bases="ACGT"}
    /^>/ {
        gsub(/^>::/, "", $1)         # remove >:: 
        split($1,a,"[:-]")           # split by : or - 
        chrom=a[1]; pos=a[2]; next
    }
    {
        ref = toupper($1)
        for(i=1;i<=length(bases);i++){
            alt = substr(bases,i,1)
            if(alt != ref){
                print chrom, pos, ref, alt
            }
        }
    }' ${MAINDIR}/Resources/gene_panel/implemented/Targets-XGEN.87EF358171F54BE7A9133DE926D12A03.chrprefix.merged.allpositions.fasta | awk '{print $1"\t"$2+1"\t"$2+1"\t"$3"\t"$4}'\
> ${MAINDIR}/Resources/gene_panel/implemented/Targets-XGEN.87EF358171F54BE7A9133DE926D12A03.chrprefix.merged.allpositionsallmutations.avinput

# annotate the mutation with annovar (install first)
${GINKGO_INST_DIR}/../annovar/table_annovar.pl \
        ${MAINDIR}/Resources/gene_panel/implemented/Targets-XGEN.87EF358171F54BE7A9133DE926D12A03.chrprefix.merged.allpositionsallmutations.avinput \
        ${GINKGO_INST_DIR}/../annovar/humandb/ \
        -buildver hg38 \
        -protocol refGene,dbnsfp42c,cosmic70,avsnp150,exac03,clinvar_20220320 \
        -remove \
        -operation g,f,f,f,f,f \
        -nastring . \
        -otherinfo \
        -out ${MAINDIR}/Resources/gene_panel/implemented/Targets-XGEN.87EF358171F54BE7A9133DE926D12A03.chrprefix.merged.allpositionsallmutations.annovar.tsv 

awk -F '\t'  '{print $1"\t"$2"\t"$3"\t"$4">"$5"\t"$6"\t"$10"\t"$7}' ${MAINDIR}/Resources/gene_panel/implemented/Targets-XGEN.87EF358171F54BE7A9133DE926D12A03.chrprefix.merged.allpositionsallmutations.annovar.tsv.hg38_multianno.txt | sed -E 's/\t(FAT1|NOTCH1|PPM1D|TP53|NOTCH2|NOTCH3|ZFP36L2):.*:p./\t/' | sed 's/\t\.\t/\tNA\t/' > ${MAINDIR}/Resources/gene_panel/implemented/Targets-XGEN.87EF358171F54BE7A9133DE926D12A03.chrprefix.merged.allpositionsallmutations.annovar.bed        

## Generate alternative and total counts and gene bed file
patient="eso29"
# I need to create the reference and the total read counts for each position with an alternative with passed filter (from read calling?)
outdir=${MAINDIR}/StartDir/${patient}/panel/preprocessing/coverage/
# Create the list 
#ls ${outdir}../*.recal.bam > $samplelist
samplelist=${outdir}/Bams.txt 
num_cells=$(wc -l $samplelist | awk '{print $1}')
sbatch --array=1-${num_cells}%15 \
  ${SCRIPTSDIR}/panel_vc/BaseCountsPosition4Mapping.sh $patient 

# Combine counts per donor
# ALT
for f in `ls ${MAINDIR}/StartDir/${patient}/panel/preprocessing/coverage/mutmapping/*alt_count.tsv`; do
    awk '{print $2}' "$f" > "${f%.tsv}_col2.tmp"
done
paste ${MAINDIR}/StartDir/${patient}/panel/preprocessing/coverage/mutmapping/*_col2.tmp > ${MAINDIR/StartDir/${patient}/panel/preprocessing/coverage/mutmapping/merged_columns.tsv
rm ${MAINDIR}/StartDir/${patient}/panel/preprocessing/coverage/mutmapping/*_col2.tmp
# Remove empty files
if [ "$patient" == "eso29" ]; then
  find ${MAINDIR}/StartDir/${patient}/panel/preprocessing/coverage/mutmapping/ -name "*_alt_count.tsv" -empty -delete
fi

onesample=$(ls ${MAINDIR}/StartDir/${patient}/panel/preprocessing/coverage/mutmapping/*_alt_count.tsv | head -n 1)

awk '{print $1}' $onesample | paste - ${MAINDIR}/StartDir/${patient}/panel/preprocessing/coverage/mutmapping/merged_columns.tsv | sed 's/.mygenes.nondup//g' | sed 's/Variant/CHROM_POS_REF_ALT/' > ${MAINDIR}/StartDir/${patient}/panel/preprocessing/coverage/mutmapping/alt_counts.tsv
# TOTAL
for f in `ls ${MAINDIR}/StartDir/${patient}/panel/preprocessing/coverage/mutmapping/*total_depth.tsv`; do
    awk '{print $2}' "$f" > "${f%.tsv}_col2.tmp"
done
paste ${MAINDIR}/StartDir/${patient}/panel/preprocessing/coverage/mutmapping/*_col2.tmp > ${MAINDIR}/StartDir/${patient}/panel/preprocessing/coverage/mutmapping/merged_columns.tsv
rm ${MAINDIR}/StartDir/${patient}/panel/preprocessing/coverage/mutmapping/*_col2.tmp
if [ "$patient" == "eso29" ]; then
  find ${MAINDIR}/StartDir/${patient}/panel/preprocessing/coverage/mutmapping/ -name "*_total_depth.tsv" -empty -delete
fi
onesample=$(ls ${MAINDIR}/StartDir/${patient}/panel/preprocessing/coverage/mutmapping/*_total_depth.tsv | head -n 1)
awk '{print $1}' $onesample | paste - ${MAINDIR}/StartDir/${patient}/panel/preprocessing/coverage/mutmapping/merged_columns.tsv | sed 's/.mygenes.nondup//g' | sed 's/Variant/CHROM_POS_REF_ALT/' > ${MAINDIR}/StartDir/${patient}/panel/preprocessing/coverage/mutmapping/total_counts.tsv

# Identify rows with no alternative reads
awk '{zero=1; for(i=2;i<=NF;i++) if($i!=0) zero=0; if(zero) print NR}' ${MAINDIR}/StartDir/${patient}/panel/preprocessing/coverage/mutmapping/alt_counts.tsv > ${MAINDIR}/StartDir/${patient}/panel/preprocessing/coverage/mutmapping/zero_rows.txt
# Remove non-zero lines
awk 'NR==FNR {rm[$1]; next} !(FNR in rm)' ${MAINDIR}/StartDir/${patient}/panel/preprocessing/coverage/mutmapping/zero_rows.txt ${MAINDIR}/StartDir/${patient}/panel/preprocessing/coverage/mutmapping/alt_counts.tsv > ${MAINDIR}/StartDir/${patient}/panel/preprocessing/coverage/mutmapping/alt_counts_filtered.tsv
awk 'NR==FNR {rm[$1]; next} !(FNR in rm)' ${MAINDIR}/StartDir/${patient}/panel/preprocessing/coverage/mutmapping/zero_rows.txt ${MAINDIR}/StartDir/${patient}/panel/preprocessing/coverage/mutmapping/total_counts.tsv > ${MAINDIR}/StartDir/${patient}/panel/preprocessing/coverage/mutmapping/total_counts_filtered.tsv
awk 'NR==FNR {rm[$1]; next} !(FNR in rm)' ${MAINDIR}/StartDir/${patient}/panel/preprocessing/coverage/mutmapping/zero_rows.txt ${MAINDIR}/Resources/gene_panel/implemented/Targets-XGEN.87EF358171F54BE7A9133DE926D12A03.chrprefix.merged.allpositionsallmutations.annovar.bed > ${MAINDIR}/StartDir/${patient}/panel/preprocessing/coverage/mutmapping/genes_filtered.bed
```

```{r }
  dplyr::select(cell, protocol,`Analysis depth`,coverage_uniformity,`% mapped reads`,breadth,pct_counts_ribo,pct_counts_mt,read_counts_total) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(`Analysis depth`,coverage_uniformity,`% mapped reads`,breadth,pct_counts_ribo,pct_counts_mt,read_counts_total)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(name=factor(name,levels=c("Analysis depth","breadth","coverage_uniformity","% mapped reads","read_counts_total","pct_counts_mt","pct_counts_ribo"))) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(name = forcats::fct_recode(name,
                                "Sequencing depth\n(x)" = "Analysis depth",
                                "Detected transcripts\nwith 1M reads"="read_counts_total",
                                "Coverage uniformity\n(1/MAD)" = "coverage_uniformity",
                                "Mapped reads\n(%)" = "% mapped reads",
                                "Genome coverage\n(%)" = "breadth",
                                "Ribosomal reads\n(%)" = "pct_counts_ribo",
                                "Mitochondrial reads\n(%)"="pct_counts_mt"))


# Wilcoxon test per 'name' between protocol groups
pvals <- benchmark_50cells_toplot %>%
  group_by(name) %>%
  rstatix::wilcox_test(value ~ protocol) %>%
  rstatix::adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%  
  dplyr::rename(p_value = p, p_adj = p.adj)
# Summary stats
summary_stats <- benchmark_50cells_toplot %>%
  dplyr::group_by(name, protocol) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(value)),
    mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd / sqrt(n),
    median = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    mad = mad(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_round = round(median(value, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    mad_round = round(mad(value, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Q1 = quantile(value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q3 = quantile(value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR = IQR(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    min = min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    max = max(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
# Combine summary stats with p-values (note: one p-value per name)
summary_stats_with_pval <- summary_stats %>%
  dplyr::left_join(pvals, by = "name")
#View(summary_stats_with_pval)

benchmark_50cells_toplot %>%
  ggplot(aes(protocol,value,fill=protocol)) +
  geom_boxplot(draw_quantiles = c(0.5), outlier.size = 0.5) +
  ggpubr::stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox", label = 'p.signif', label.x = 1.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("lightpink","lightblue")) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom", 
        axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) +
  labs(x="",y="", fill="") +
  facet_wrap(. ~ name, scales = "free", ncol = 7)
```

### Corrected mutation burden (I)

```{bash}

# Obtain the table from the VCF to compute mutation burden before mutation mapping
bash ${SCRIPTSDIR}/Burden.nomapping.sh ${MAINDIR}/StartDir/${PATIENT}/manual_collate/sequoia/classifier/myselectedvars.snvswithsingletons.classifierfiltered.nocontaminatedcells.vcf.gz

```

```{r}


ObtainMutations <-  function(patient){
  
  print(patient)
    table_snvs <- paste0(input_figs, "myselectedvars.snvswithsingletons.classifierfiltered.nocontaminatedcells.",patient,".4round3burden.table")     
  
    phenotypes_rna <- readRDS(paste0(input_figs,"phenotypes_rna_raw.",patient,".rds")) %>%
      dplyr::rename(cell=`sample name`) %>%
      dplyr::select(cell, cell_type, `Cell Type`, sort)
    
      immune <-  read.table (file = paste0(input_figs, "/immune.",patient,".txt")) %>% unlist() %>% as.vector()

      recallv0 <- data.table::fread(paste0(input_figs, "/Recall.summary.",patient,".txt"), col.names = c("carryingalt","totalv0","recallv0","cell"))

    AllMutations <- data.table::fread(table_snvs, sep = "\t") %>%
      dplyr::mutate(mypatient = patient) %>%
      dplyr::filter(!(CHROM %in% c("chrX", "chrY")))
    data.table::setDT(AllMutations)  

    AllMutations[, variant_id := paste0(CHROM, ":", POS, "_", REF, ">", ALT)]
    
    # calculate trinucleotide context counts
    AllMutations[, trinuc_context := as.character(
      BSgenome::getSeq(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38::BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38, names = CHROM, start = POS - 1, end = POS + 1)
    )]
    AllMutations[, is_purine := REF %in% c("A", "G")]
    AllMutations[is_purine == TRUE, `:=`(
      trinuc_context = as.character(Biostrings::reverseComplement(Biostrings::DNAStringSet(trinuc_context))),
      REF = as.character(complement(Biostrings::DNAStringSet(REF))),
      ALT = as.character(complement(Biostrings::DNAStringSet(ALT)))
    )]
    AllMutations[, mut_type := paste0(substr(trinuc_context, 1, 1), "[", REF, ">", ALT, "]", substr(trinuc_context, 3, 3))]

    
    bases <- c("A","C","G","T")
    subs  <- c("C>A","C>G","C>T","T>A","T>C","T>G")
    context96 <- as.vector(sapply(subs, function(s) {
      paste0(rep(bases, each = 4), "[", s, "]", rep(bases, times = 4))
    }))
    AllMutations[, mut_type := factor(mut_type, levels = context96)]
    
    vaf_cols <- colnames(AllMutations)[grepl(".VAF$", colnames(AllMutations))]
    AllMutations_vaf <- as.matrix(AllMutations[, ..vaf_cols])
    rownames(AllMutations_vaf) <- AllMutations$variant_id 
    AllMutations_bin <- (AllMutations_vaf > 0.05) * 1
    colnames(AllMutations_bin) <- gsub(".VAF", "", colnames(AllMutations_bin))

    MutationBurdenAll <- colSums(AllMutations_bin, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    counts_96 <- rowsum(AllMutations_bin, group = AllMutations$mut_type, na.rm = TRUE)
    MutationBurdenAll_96 <- matrix(0, nrow = 96, ncol = ncol(AllMutations_bin),
                                    dimnames = list(context96, colnames(AllMutations_bin)))
    MutationBurdenAll_96[rownames(counts_96), ] <- counts_96
    
  
    mutation_count <- rowSums(AllMutations_bin, na.rm = TRUE)
    AllMutations_bin_filtered <- AllMutations_bin[mutation_count > 1, ]
    MutationBurden_filtered <- colSums(AllMutations_bin_filtered, na.rm = TRUE)

    
    MutationBurdenAll_96_table <- t(MutationBurdenAll_96) %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column("cell")
    
    MutationBurdenNoMapping_table <- cbind(mutations=as.numeric(MutationBurdenAll),
                                           mutations_shared=as.numeric(MutationBurden_filtered),
                                           cell=colnames(AllMutations_bin),
                                           project="SMART-PTA (no mapping)",
                                           donor=patient
                                           ) %>% as.data.frame() %>%
      dplyr::mutate(mutations=as.numeric(mutations),
                    mutations_shared=as.numeric(mutations_shared)) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(type=ifelse(cell %in% immune,"immune","epithelial")) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(phenotypes_rna) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(MutationBurdenAll_96_table, by = "cell") %>%
      dplyr::left_join(recallv0, by="cell") 
    
   return(MutationBurdenNoMapping_table)
}

AllMutations <- do.call("rbind",lapply(X=c("cu03","cu08","eso29","cu01","cu02"),ObtainMutations))
```

### Phylogenetic correlation cell states (B)

```{r path main}

patient <- "cu08"
mytree <- readRDS(paste0(input_figs, "/phylogeny.",patient,".RDS"))


  # use topology (node distance) instead of branch length to avoid circularity (immune-epi divergence is used for calibration)
  Winv <- PATH::one_node_tree_dist(mytree@phylo, norm = FALSE)

  # select the phenotypic information of the tips  
  all_data <-  mytree@data
  all_data <- all_data[1:length(mytree@phylo$tip.label),colnames(all_data)]

  all_data <- all_data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(replicate=ifelse(is.na(replicate),substr(gsub(".*_","",label2),4,4), replicate)) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(row=ifelse(is.na(row),substr(gsub(".*_","",label2),5,5), row)) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(col=ifelse(is.na(col),substr(gsub(".*_","",label2),5,nchar(label2)), col)) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(pct_counts_ribo=ifelse(is.na(pct_counts_ribo),0, pct_counts_ribo)) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(pct_counts_mt=ifelse(is.na(pct_counts_mt),0, pct_counts_mt)) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(total_counts=ifelse(is.na(total_counts),0, total_counts)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(celltype=as.factor(celltype))

  celltypes_discrete <- PATH::catMat(as.numeric(all_data$celltype)) 
  colnames(celltypes_discrete) <- levels(all_data$celltype)[1:ncol(celltypes_discrete)]
  
  
  celltypes_discrete2 <- cbind(celltypes_discrete, 
                              `Negative control\n(% unmapped reads)`=all_data$`% unmapped reads`
                    )
  xcor_celltypes <- PATH::xcor(data = celltypes_discrete2, 
                      weight.matrix = Winv) 
  
  
  # Create barplot for the heatmap
  # transform into presabs
  celltypes_discrete2_presabs <- celltypes_discrete2
  celltypes_discrete2_presabs[celltypes_discrete2>0] <- 1
  col_counts <- log(colSums(celltypes_discrete2_presabs))
  bar_colors <- c("lightgrey")
  # Create column annotation
  ha <- ComplexHeatmap::HeatmapAnnotation(
    "Number of cells\n(log scale)" = ComplexHeatmap::anno_barplot(col_counts,gp = gpar(fill = bar_colors, col=bar_colors), border = FALSE,
                                      axis_param = list(at = log(c(10, 100, 1000)), # Log scale positions on the axis
                                      labels = c("10", "100", "1000")) # Log scale axis
)
  )
  
    # Create a mapping of cell types to colors
    cell_type_colors <- c("CD45+" = "tomato", "EPCAM+" = "skyblue", 
                          "Negative control\n(% unmapped reads)"="lightgrey")
    # Create row annotation for cell types
    row_ha <- rowAnnotation(
      "Cell type" = anno_simple(colnames(celltypes_discrete2), col = cell_type_colors)
    )
    ha_celltypes <- HeatmapAnnotation(
      "Cell type" = anno_simple(colnames(celltypes_discrete2), col = cell_type_colors)
    )
    
  # Convert p-values to significance symbols
  symbol_pvaluematrix <- apply(xcor_celltypes$one.sided.pvalue, c(1, 2), 
                         function(p) {
                           if (p < 0.001) {
                             return("***")
                             } else if (p < 0.01) {
                               return("**")
                               } else if (p < 0.05) {
                                 return("*")
                                 } else {
                                   return("ns") # No symbol for p >= 0.05
                                   }})

  col_fun = circlize::colorRamp2(c(min(as.vector(xcor_celltypes$Z.score)),0,max(as.vector(xcor_celltypes$Z.score))), 
                       c("brown2", "white", "darkblue"))
  pdf(paste0(fig_dir, "Crosscorrelation.",patient,".pdf"), width = 8, height = 6)
  ht <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(xcor_celltypes$Z.score, name="Phylogenetic correlation\n(Z score)",
                          show_column_dend = F, 
                          cluster_rows = F, cluster_columns = F,
                          show_row_dend = F, 
                          #top_annotation = ha, # Add the column annotation here
                          right_annotation = row_ha,
                          bottom_annotation = ha_celltypes,
                          col=col_fun,
                          heatmap_legend_param = list(
                                 legend_direction = "vertical"),
                            # Add p-value symbols on top of the heatmap as annotations
                            cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
                                     grid.text(symbol_pvaluematrix[i, j], x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, col = "black"))
                            }
                          )
  draw(ht, heatmap_legend_side = "right")
  dev.off()
```

### Phylogenetic cross-correlation region and cell type (C)
```{r}

patient <- "cu08"
mytree <- readRDS(paste0(input_figs, "/phylogeny.",patient,".RDS"))


  # Create a tree just with epithelial
  immune_cells <- mytree %>% as_tibble() %>% 
    dplyr::select(label,celltype) %>% 
    dplyr::filter(celltype=="CD45+") %>% 
    dplyr::select(label) %>% unlist()
  mytree_epi <- treeio::drop.tip(mytree,c("germline",immune_cells))
  # Calculate phylogenetic distance matrix
  Winv <- PATH::inv_tree_dist(mytree_epi@phylo, node = TRUE, norm = FALSE)
  # Create phenotypic matrix
  phenotypic_data <- mytree_epi@data[1:length(mytree_epi@phylo$tip.label),colnames(mytree_epi@data)]
  xcor_epi_region_all <- PATH::xcor(data = phenotypic_data %>% dplyr::select(`cm.from.mouth`) %>% as.matrix(), 
                      weight.matrix = Winv) 

  # IMMUNE
  epi_cells <- mytree %>% as_tibble() %>% 
    dplyr::select(label,celltype) %>% 
    dplyr::filter(celltype=="EPCAM+") %>% 
    dplyr::select(label) %>% unlist()
  mytree_immune <- treeio::drop.tip(mytree,c("germline",epi_cells))
  Winv <- PATH::inv_tree_dist(mytree_immune@phylo, node = TRUE, norm = FALSE)
  phenotypic_data <- mytree_immune@data[1:length(mytree_immune@phylo$tip.label),colnames(mytree_immune@data)]
  xcor_immune_region_all <- PATH::xcor(data = phenotypic_data %>% dplyr::select(`cm.from.mouth`) %>% as.matrix(), 
                      weight.matrix = Winv) 

  # SPLIT THE TREE AND ADD REPLICATES
  # split tips in random groups
  tip_groups <- split(mytree_epi@phylo$tip.label, cut(seq_along(mytree_epi@phylo$tip.label), breaks = 5, labels = FALSE))
  xcor_epi_region <- vector("list", length = 5)
        for (i in seq_along(tip_groups)) {
          tips_to_keep <- tip_groups[[i]]
        
          # Prune tree to keep only this group
          tree_subset <- treeio::drop.tip(mytree_epi, setdiff(mytree_epi@phylo$tip.label, tips_to_keep))
        
          # Compute inverse distance matrix
          Winv <- PATH::inv_tree_dist(tree_subset@phylo, node = TRUE, norm = FALSE)
        
          # Get phenotypic data for the selected tips
          phenodata_subset <- tree_subset@data[1:length(tree_subset@phylo$tip.label),colnames(tree_subset@data)]
          # Run PATH (example with one phenotype column)
          result <- PATH::xcor(
            data = phenodata_subset %>% dplyr::select(`cm.from.mouth`) %>% as.matrix(),
            weight.matrix = Winv
          )
        
          xcor_epi_region[[i]] <- result
        }
   # split tips in 10 random groups
  tip_groups <- split(mytree_immune@phylo$tip.label, cut(seq_along(mytree_immune@phylo$tip.label), breaks = 5, labels = FALSE))
  xcor_immune_region <- vector("list", length = 5)
        for (i in seq_along(tip_groups)) {
          tips_to_keep <- tip_groups[[i]]
          tree_subset <- treeio::drop.tip(mytree_immune, setdiff(mytree_immune@phylo$tip.label, tips_to_keep))
          Winv <- PATH::inv_tree_dist(tree_subset@phylo, node = TRUE, norm = FALSE)
          phenodata_subset <- tree_subset@data[1:length(tree_subset@phylo$tip.label),colnames(tree_subset@data)]
          result <- PATH::xcor(
            data = phenodata_subset %>% dplyr::select(`cm.from.mouth`) %>% as.matrix(),
            weight.matrix = Winv
          )
          xcor_immune_region[[i]] <- result
        }
  
    # Add source labels before combining
    xcor_epi_df <- bind_rows(
      lapply(seq_along(xcor_epi_region), function(i) {
        xcor_epi_region[[i]] %>% 
          as.data.frame() %>% 
          mutate(region = paste0("EPCAM+_", i))
      })
    )
    
    xcor_immune_df <- bind_rows(
      lapply(seq_along(xcor_immune_region), function(i) {
        xcor_immune_region[[i]] %>% 
          as.data.frame() %>% 
          mutate(region = paste0("CD45+_", i))
      })
    )
    
    # Merge into one
    xcor_all_df <- bind_rows(xcor_epi_df, xcor_immune_df) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(celltype=gsub("_.*","",region)) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(celltype=factor(celltype, levels=c("EPCAM+","CD45+")))

    xcor_all_df_clean <- xcor_all_df %>%
      filter(!is.na(cm.from.mouth.1))
    
    # Calculate summary stats per celltype
    summary_df <- xcor_all_df_clean %>%
      group_by(celltype) %>%
      summarise(
        mean_xcor = mean(cm.from.mouth.1, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_xcor = sd(cm.from.mouth.1, na.rm = TRUE),
        n = dplyr::n(),
        se_xcor = sd_xcor / sqrt(n)
      )

    # Plot with error bars
    ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = celltype, y = mean_xcor, fill = celltype)) +
      geom_col(width = 0.6) +
```

```{r}
donor <- "cu02"

ltttable <- function(donor,myregion){
      
    tree <- readRDS(paste0(input_figs,"/phylogeny.",donor,".RDS"))
    
      regionsdiscard <- tree %>% as_tibble() %>% 
        dplyr::select(label,region) %>% 
            dplyr::filter(region!=myregion) %>%
            dplyr::select(label) %>% unlist()
      tree.region <- treeio::drop.tip(tree, tip = regionsdiscard)
      immune <- tree.region %>% as_tibble() %>% 
        dplyr::select(label,celltype) %>% 
            dplyr::filter(celltype=="CD45+") %>%
            dplyr::select(label) %>% unlist()
      epi <- tree.region %>% as_tibble() %>% 
        dplyr::select(label,celltype) %>% 
            dplyr::filter(celltype=="EPCAM+") %>%
            dplyr::select(label) %>% unlist()
      if (length(immune)<=2){
        immune.ltt2 <- NULL
      } else{
        immune.tree <- treeio::drop.tip(tree.region, tip = epi)
        print(paste0("Remaining cells:",length(immune.tree@phylo$tip.label)))
        ltt.immune <- ape::ltt.plot.coords(immune.tree@phylo, backward = FALSE)
        immune.ltt2 <- data.frame(time = ltt.immune[,1], 
                                lineages = ltt.immune[,2], 
                                cell_type = "CD45+",
                                region=myregion)
      }

      if (length(epi)<=2){
        epi.ltt2 <- NULL
      } else {
        epi.tree <- treeio::drop.tip(tree.region, tip = immune)
            print(paste0("Remaining cells:",length(epi.tree@phylo$tip.label)))
        ltt.epi <- ape::ltt.plot.coords(epi.tree@phylo, backward = FALSE)
        epi.ltt2 <- data.frame(time = ltt.epi[,1], 
                               lineages = ltt.epi[,2], 
                               cell_type = "EPCAM+", 
                               region=myregion)
      } 
      mytable <- rbind(immune.ltt2,epi.ltt2) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(donor=donor)
      return(mytable)  
}
```

### CD45+ tree (E)

```{r}

# Number of clones and size after birth
# cut after birth
cut_age <- 0.7501

ClonalSizeCalculation <- function(donor) {
    tree_data <- readRDS(paste0(input_figs, "phylogeny.",donor,".RDS"))
    tree <- tree_data@phylo
    
    # Get node depths (from root)
    node_depths <- node.depth.edgelength(tree)
    
    # Find edges that cross the threshold (cutting point)
    crossing_edges <- which(
      node_depths[tree$edge[, 1]] < cut_age &
      node_depths[tree$edge[, 2]] >= cut_age
    )
    
    # Get child nodes immediately above the cut
    post_cut_nodes <- tree$edge[crossing_edges, 2]
    
    # Function to get descendants of a node
    get_descendants <- function(tree, node) {
      phangorn::Descendants(tree, node, type = "all")[[1]]
    }
    
    # Find descendants for each post-cut node
    all_descendants <- sapply(post_cut_nodes, function(node) get_descendants(tree, node))
    
    # Flatten and get unique list of descendants
    all_descendants_flat <- unique(unlist(all_descendants))
    
    # Optional: Get labels for those nodes
    tip_labels <- tree$tip.label
    internal_labels <- tree$node.label
    Ntip <- length(tip_labels)
    
    # Remove any nodes that are descendants of another post-cut node but keep terminal nodes
    # Identify tips among post_cut_nodes
    tips_in_post_cut <- post_cut_nodes[post_cut_nodes <= Ntip]
    # Keep internal post_cut_nodes that are not descendants of others
    internal_nodes <- post_cut_nodes[post_cut_nodes > Ntip]
    all_internal_descendants <- unique(unlist(sapply(internal_nodes, get_descendants, tree = tree)))
    final_internal_nodes <- internal_nodes[!internal_nodes %in% all_internal_descendants]
    # Combine tips and filtered internal nodes
    final_post_cut_nodes <- c(tips_in_post_cut, final_internal_nodes)
    
    # Function to get leaf descendants of a node
    get_leaf_descendants <- function(tree, node) {
      desc <- phangorn::Descendants(tree, node, type = "tips")[[1]]
      type<- cbind(label=tree$tip.label[desc]) %>%
        as.data.frame() %>%
        dplyr::left_join(tree_data %>% as_tibble()) %>%
        dplyr::select(celltype, bootstrap, region) 
      types <- paste0(unique(substr(as.vector(type$celltype), 1, 1)), collapse = "")
      regions <- paste0(unique(substr(as.vector(type$region), 1, 1)), collapse = "")
     out <- cbind(num_tips=length(desc), tips_type=types, region=regions)
      return(out)  # Return number of leaf descendants (tips)
    }
    
    # Find the number of leaf descendants for each post-cut node
    # takes a few seconds to run
    descendants <- do.call("rbind",lapply(final_post_cut_nodes, function(node) get_leaf_descendants(tree, node)))
    descendants_counts <- descendants[,1]
    descendants_types <- descendants[,2]
    descendants_regions <- descendants[,3]

    
    # Match labels to remaining post-cut nodes
    remaining_labels <- sapply(final_post_cut_nodes, function(n) {
      if (n <= Ntip) tip_labels[n] else internal_labels[n - Ntip]
    })
    
    # Final result with descendant count
    result <- data.frame(
      node = final_post_cut_nodes,
      label = remaining_labels,
      n_descendants = descendants_counts, 
      type=descendants_types,
      region=descendants_regions,
      donor=donor
    )
    
    return(result)
}


clonesize_all <- do.call("rbind",lapply(c("eso29","cu01","cu02","cu03","cu08"),ClonalSizeCalculation))
```

```{r}

# Compare epithelial largest clones under a birth-death model
library(ape)         
library(diversitree)

    patient <- "cu02"
    tree_all_info_annotated <- readRDS(paste0(input_figs,"phylogeny.",patient,".RDS"))
    node_data <- tree_all_info_annotated@phylo$node.label

# "N590"
      clone_id <- "N590"
      print(paste0("Clone: ",clone_id))
      node_index <- which(node_data == clone_id) + length(tree_all_info_annotated@phylo$tip.label)
      print(node_index)
      clade1 <- extract.clade(tree_all_info_annotated@phylo, node = node_index)

# "N647"
  clone_id <- "N647"
      print(paste0("Clone: ",clone_id))
      node_index <- which(node_data == clone_id) + length(tree_all_info_annotated@phylo$tip.label)
      print(node_index)
      clade2 <- extract.clade(tree_all_info_annotated@phylo, node = node_index)
 

# Create likelihood functions for each tree
lik_bd1 <- make.bd(clade1,sampling.f= 50/10000)
lik_bd2 <- make.bd(clade2,sampling.f= 50/10000)

# Fit birth-death model separately for each tree (alternative hypothesis)
fit1 <- find.mle(lik_bd1, x.init = c(lambda = 0.15, mu = 0.149), method = "subplex")
# confirm MLE is stable initiating with other values
fit1b <- find.mle(lik_bd1, c(lambda=0.3, mu=0.1), method = "subplex")
fit1c <- find.mle(lik_bd1, c(lambda=0.5, mu=0.7), method = "subplex")
fit1$lnLik
fit1b$lnLik
fit1c$lnLik

fit2 <- find.mle(lik_bd2, x.init = c(lambda = 0.15, mu = 0.149),  method = "subplex")
# confirm MLE is stable initiating with other values
fit2b <- find.mle(lik_bd2, c(lambda=0.3, mu=0.1), method = "subplex")
fit2c <- find.mle(lik_bd2, c(lambda=0.5, mu=0.7), method = "subplex")
fit2$lnLik
fit2b$lnLik
fit2c$lnLik


lnL_alt <- fit1$lnLik + fit2$lnLik

# Joint likelihood assuming shared birth and death rates (null hypothesis)
joint_lik <- function(par) {
  lik_bd1(par) + lik_bd2(par)
}
fit_null <- find.mle(joint_lik, x.init = c(lambda = 0.15, mu = 0.149), method = "subplex")
lnL_null <- fit_null$lnLik
fit_nullb <- find.mle(joint_lik, x.init = c(lambda = 0.3, mu = 0.1), method = "subplex")
fit_nullb$lnLik
fit_nullc <- find.mle(joint_lik, x.init = c(lambda = 0.5, mu = 0.7), method = "subplex")
fit_nullc$lnLik


# Likelihood ratio test statistic
LR_stat <- 2 * (lnL_alt - lnL_null)
LR_stat
p_value <- pchisq(LR_stat, df = 2, lower.tail = FALSE)
p_value

# Output results
cat("Likelihood Ratio Test for different birth-death rates\n")
cat(sprintf("LogLik Null (shared rates): %.3f\n", lnL_null))
cat(sprintf("LogLik Alternative (different rates): %.3f\n", lnL_alt))
cat(sprintf("LR statistic: %.3f\n", LR_stat))
cat(sprintf("p-value: %.20f\n", p_value))
```

### Trinucleotide profiles and signatures (C)

```{r}

library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)


CreateTrinucleotideProfiles <- function(patient, mytime=40){
  
    donor.tree <- readRDS(paste0(input_figs,"phylogeny.",patient,".RDS"))
    donor.tibble <- as_tibble(donor.tree)
    immune.nodes <- c(na.omit(donor.tibble[donor.tibble$celltype == "CD45+",]$label))
    donor.tree.ep <- treeio::drop.tip(donor.tree, immune.nodes)
    donor.tibble.ep <- as_tibble(donor.tree.ep)
    donor.table <- vroom::vroom(paste0(input_figs,"myselectedvars.snvswithsingletons.classifierfiltered.nocontaminatedcells.treemut.",
                                       patient,".table"))
    donor.tibble.ep$profile.x <- substr(donor.tibble.ep$profile.x, 1, nchar(donor.tibble.ep$profile.x)-1)
    donor.tibble.ep <- donor.tibble.ep[, c("profile.x", "label", "celltype", "DivTime")]
    input.muts <- donor.table[c("CHROM", "POS", "REF", "ALT", "branch")]
    names(input.muts) <- c("chr", "pos", "ref", "alt", "branch")
    donor.tibble.ep <- donor.tibble.ep %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      is_tip    = grepl("^(eso|cu)", label),
      profile.x = if_else(is_tip, label, profile.x)
    )
    input.muts <- dplyr::inner_join(
      input.muts,
      donor.tibble.ep %>% dplyr::select(-label),
      by = c("branch" = "profile.x")
    )
        input.muts$branch <- NULL
    input.muts <- input.muts %>% dplyr::mutate(branch_bin = case_when(
      is_tip                ~ "Terminal",
      DivTime <  mytime     ~ "Recent",
      DivTime >= mytime     ~ "Not_Recent",
      TRUE                  ~ NA_character_
    ))
    
    input.muts <- as.data.frame(input.muts)
    donor.input.bin <- deconstructSigs::mut.to.sigs.input(mut.ref = input.muts,
                                        sample.id = "branch_bin",
                                        chr = "chr",
                                        pos = "pos",
                                        ref = "ref",
                                        alt = "alt",
                                        bsg = BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
    
    dir.create(paste0(input_figs,"/signatures/"))
    write.csv(donor.input.bin, paste0(input_figs, "/signatures/",patient,"_input_halves_bin.csv"))
      return(donor.input.bin)

}

MakeTrinucleotidePlots <- function(patient) {
  
  input <- data.table::fread(paste0(input_figs,"/signatures/",patient,"_input_halves_bin.csv"))
  input <- input %>% 
    tibble::column_to_rownames("V1")

  triN.df <- data.frame()
  for(sample in rownames(input)){
    message(sample)
    v = deconstructSigs::whichSignatures(tumor.ref = input, 
                       #signatures.ref = subset_transpose_COSMIC_2022,
                       contexts.needed = TRUE,
                       signature.cutoff = 0,
                       sample.id = sample)
    
    
    triN <- v$tumor
    triN.df <- rbind(triN.df, triN)
  }
  triN.df <- data.frame(t(triN.df))
  
  
  triN.df$triN <- paste0(stringr::str_sub(rownames(triN.df), 1,1),
                         stringr::str_sub(rownames(triN.df), 3,3),
```

```{r}
# Creating a branch mapping string for singletons
# Create a vector with strings specifying the position of the cell
CreateDictionaryBranch <- function(donor){
      cell_order <- scan(paste0(input_figs,"PhylogenyMappingTipOrder.",donor,".txt"),what = character())
      myvars <- fread(paste0(input_figs,"myselectedvars.snvswithsingletons.classifierfiltered.nocontaminatedcells.treemut.",donor,".table"),nrows = 2, header = T,sep = "\t")
    cell_vcf <- gsub(".VAF","",colnames(myvars)[grepl(paste0(donor,".*",".VAF$"),colnames(myvars))])
    length(cell_vcf)
    # Create arrays 
      indices <- c(1:length(cell_order))
      # Create a matrix of zeros
      n <- length(indices)
      max_index <- max(indices)
      result <- matrix(0, nrow = n, ncol = max_index)
      # Assign 1 at the specified positions
      result[cbind(1:n, indices)] <- 1
      string_array <- apply(result, 1, paste0, collapse = "")
      sub_dict <- setNames(string_array, cell_order)
      return(sub_dict)
}

sub_dict <- c(
  CreateDictionaryBranch("eso29"),
  CreateDictionaryBranch("cu01"),
  CreateDictionaryBranch("cu02"),
  CreateDictionaryBranch("cu03"),
  CreateDictionaryBranch("cu08")
)

# Proportion mutant cells: syn + nonsyn
    ProportionMutationsPerCell <- function(mydonor){
    
  df <- aamutations_CADD %>%
  dplyr::filter(donor==mydonor) %>%
  dplyr::select(id, ExonicFunc.refGene,branch) 
  
  if(nrow(df) == 0){
    # number of cells
    ncells<- aamutations_CADD %>% dplyr::filter(donor==mydonor) %>% dplyr::filter(!grepl("_",branch0)) %>% head(1) %>% 
      dplyr::select(branch0) %>% nchar()
    output <- cbind(muts_percell=0, ncells=as.numeric(ncells), donor=mydonor) %>% as.data.frame()
    return(output)
    
  } else {
    mutation_strings <- df$branch
    mutation_list <- lapply(mutation_strings, function(x) as.integer(strsplit(x, "")[[1]]))
    # Create matrix: rows = variants, columns = cells
    mutation_matrix <- do.call(rbind, mutation_list)
    rownames(mutation_matrix) <- df$id
    table(colSums(mutation_matrix))
      
    output <- colSums(mutation_matrix) %>%
      table() %>%
      cbind() %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column("muts_percell") %>%
      dplyr::rename(ncells=".") %>%
      dplyr::mutate(donor=mydonor)
    return(output)   
    }
 }

  
NumSNVs_genesofinterest_percell <- do.call("rbind",lapply(X = c("eso29","cu01","cu02","cu03","cu08"),FUN=ProportionMutationsPerCell)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(muts_percell=ifelse(muts_percell>2,2,muts_percell)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(muts_percell,donor) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(ncells=sum(as.numeric(ncells),na.rm = T)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()  %>%
      dplyr::mutate(donor=gsub("cu08","eso05",gsub("cu03","eso04",
                                                   gsub("cu02","eso03",gsub("cu01","eso02",
                                                                            gsub("eso29", "eso01",donor)))))) %>%
     # dplyr::filter(donor %in% c("eso02","eso04")) %>%
      mutate(
        mut_category = case_when(
          muts_percell == 0 ~ "Wild-type",
          muts_percell == 1 ~ "Single SNV mutant",
          muts_percell > 1 ~ "Multiple SNV mutant"
        )
      ) 
    total_cells <- NumSNVs_genesofinterest_percell %>% dplyr::group_by(donor) %>% dplyr::summarise(n=sum(ncells)) %>% dplyr::ungroup()
    counts_matrix <- NumSNVs_genesofinterest_percell %>%
      dplyr::select(-muts_percell) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = mut_category, values_from = ncells, values_fill = 0) %>%
      tibble::column_to_rownames("donor") %>%
      as.matrix()


    # pairwise comparisons
    # Get all pairwise combinations
    pairs <- combn(rownames(counts_matrix), 2, simplify = FALSE)
    
    if (sum(grepl("Multiple",colnames(counts_matrix)))>0){
      print("yes")
      new_count_matrix <- cbind(cbind(counts_matrix[, c("Single SNV mutant")] + 
                                               counts_matrix[, c("Multiple SNV mutant")]), 
                                       cbind(counts_matrix[, c("Wild-type")]))
    } else {
      new_count_matrix <- cbind(cbind(counts_matrix[, c("Single SNV mutant")]), 
                                       cbind(counts_matrix[, c("Wild-type")]))

    }
    
    # Run Fisher's test for each pair
    pairwise_results <- lapply(pairs, function(pair) {
      subtable <- new_count_matrix[pair, ]
      test <- fisher.test(subtable)
      tibble::tibble(
        donor1 = pair[1],
        donor2 = pair[2],
        p_value = test$p.value
      )
    })
    # Combine results
    pairwise_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(pairwise_results)
    pairwise_df <- pairwise_df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"))
    pairwise_df
    
    label_df <- data.frame(
  x = rep(1.5, nrow(pairwise_df)),  # same x if you want them aligned vertically
  y = seq(1.05, 1.05 + 0.05 * (nrow(pairwise_df) - 1), by = 0.05),  # stack vertically
  label = apply(pairwise_df, 1, function(row) paste(row, collapse = " "))
)

  S_NS_plot <-  NumSNVs_genesofinterest_percell  %>%
      dplyr::select(-muts_percell) %>%
      group_by(donor) %>%
      mutate(prop=ncells/sum(ncells)) %>%
          dplyr::ungroup() %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = donor, y = prop, fill = mut_category)) +
      geom_col(width = 0.5) +
      theme_classic() +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c(`Wild-type`= "gray90", `Single SNV mutant` = "#93d6e7", `Multiple SNV mutant` = "#287b8e")) +
      labs(
        x = "Donor",
        y = "Proportion of cells",
        fill = ""
      ) +
      theme(legend.position = "top") +guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 3)) +
      geom_text(data = label_df, aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3)
 
      S_NS_plot 
    ggsave(paste0(fig_dir,"Proportion_mutated_cells_pvalues_CADD_28selectedgenes_withcu08.pdf"), width = 3, height = 6)
    
  
# PROPORTION OF CELLS CARRYING MUTATIONS IN EACH GENE
   
ProportionGeneMutationsPerCell <- function(mydonor){
    
  df <- aamutations_CADD %>%
   dplyr::filter(CADD_Phred>=20) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(donor %in% c(mydonor)) %>%
    dplyr::rename(Gene=gene.y) %>%
  dplyr::select(id, Gene,branch) 
  
  unique(df$Gene)
  PropPerGene <- function(mygene){
  
  dfgene <- df %>%
      dplyr::filter(Gene==mygene) 
    mutation_strings <- dfgene %>%
      dplyr::select(branch) %>% unlist() %>% as.vector()
    mutation_list <- lapply(mutation_strings, function(x) as.integer(strsplit(x, "")[[1]]))
    # Create matrix: rows = variants, columns = cells
    mutation_matrix <- do.call(rbind, mutation_list)
    rownames(mutation_matrix) <- dfgene$id
    table(colSums(mutation_matrix))
    perc <- sum(table(colSums(mutation_matrix))[-1])/sum(table(colSums(mutation_matrix)))
      
    output <-  cbind(mygene,perc) %>% as.data.frame() %>%
      dplyr::mutate(donor=mydonor)
    return(output) 
    }
      out <- do.call("rbind",lapply(unique(df$Gene), PropPerGene)) %>%
        arrange(perc)
      return(out)
}
```

```{r}
    myvars <- data.table::fread(table_snvs, sep = "\t") 
    
    # Create a vector with strings specifying the position of the cell
    # order as the phylogeny
    cell_order <- scan(paste0(input_figs, "PhylogenyMappingTipOrder.",patient,".txt"),what = character())
      cell_vcf <- gsub(".VAF","",colnames(myvars)[grepl(paste0(patient,".*",".VAF$"),colnames(myvars))])
      length(cell_vcf)
      # Create arrays 
      indices <- c(1:length(cell_order))
      # Create a matrix of zeros
      n <- length(indices)
      max_index <- max(indices)
      result <- matrix(0, nrow = n, ncol = max_index)
      # Assign 1 at the specified positions
      result[cbind(1:n, indices)] <- 1
      # I think the arrays have a zero at the beginning
      string_array <- apply(result, 1, paste0, collapse = "")
      sub_dict <- setNames(string_array, cell_order)
    
      
    mapped_shared <- myvars %>%
      dplyr::mutate(id=paste0(CHROM,":",POS,"_",REF,">",ALT)) %>%
         dplyr::select(c(id,Gene.refGene,Func.refGene,
                      ExonicFunc.refGene,AAChange.refGene,
                      branch)) %>%
                      #    branch,PTA_REPLISEQ)) %>%
      dplyr::filter(Func.refGene!=".") %>%
      dplyr::mutate(branch0=branch) %>%
      # transform cell name to array 
      dplyr::mutate(branch = case_when(
        grepl(patient, branch) ~ sub_dict[branch],
        TRUE ~ branch
      )) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(num_count=gsub("0","",branch)) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(num_count=nchar(num_count)) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(num_count_class=ifelse(num_count==1,"1 cell",ifelse(num_count>4,">4 cells","2-4 cells")))  %>%
        dplyr::mutate(num_count_class=factor(as.factor(num_count_class),levels=c(">4 cells","2-4 cells","1 cell"))) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(Func.refGene=factor(as.factor(Func.refGene),levels=c("intergenic","upstream","UTR5","exonic","intronic","splicing","UTR3","downstream","ncRNA_intronic","ncRNA_exonic","upstream\\x3bdownstream"))) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(donor=patient)
    
      return(mapped_shared)
    
}

AllMutationsInGenes <- do.call("rbind",lapply(X=c("cu08","eso29","cu01","cu02","cu03"),ObtainMutations))
```

```{r}
# CALCULATE DNDS FOR ALL THE MUTATIONS AND PER GENE #
SelectionPerDonor <- function(donor){
  
  print(donor)
  dndsout <- dndscv(mutations %>%
                      dplyr::filter(sampleID==donor) %>%
                          dplyr::filter(pos != lag(as.numeric(pos)) + 1 | is.na(lag(as.numeric(pos)))) %>% # remove second mutation if consecutive mutations annovar inheritance
                        dplyr::mutate(chr=gsub("chr","",chr)),
                        gene_list=c("TP53","FAT1","TTN"),
                        max_coding_muts_per_sample=1000000, # increase to include all mutations
                        max_muts_per_gene_per_sample=1000, # increase to include all genes
                        outmats=TRUE,
                        refdb=RefCDS,
                        cv=covs)
  dndsout$globaldnds
  dndsout$nbreg$theta
  ci = geneci(dndsout,
              gene_list = c("TP53","FAT1","TTN")) 


  myoutput=list(global=dndsout$globaldnds %>% dplyr::mutate(donor=donor),
                theta=cbind(theta=dndsout$nbreg$theta,donor=donor) %>% as.data.frame(),
                pergene_withcovariates=dndsout$sel_cv %>% dplyr::mutate(donor=donor),
                pergene_nocovariates=dndsout$sel_loc %>% dplyr::mutate(donor=donor),
                exclud_mutations=exclmuts_df <- if (is.null(dndsout$exclmuts)) {
                  tibble(chr = character(),
                         pos = integer(),
                         ref = character(),
                         mut = character(),
                         sampleID = character(),
                         donor = character())
                } else {
                  dndsout$exclmuts %>% mutate(donor = donor)
                },
                ci=ci %>% dplyr::mutate(donor=donor))
  return(myoutput)
    
}
```

```{r}
# TP53 cell bias

# Prepare data + Clopper-Pearson CI with binom.test
plotdata <- burden_highres %>% dplyr::rename(cell_name=cell) %>%
   dplyr::full_join(clones_combined %>%
              dplyr::rename(cell_name=cell) %>%
                dplyr::mutate(TP53clone=ifelse(grepl("TP53",V6),"Mutant","Wildtype")) %>%
                dplyr::select(cell_name,TP53clone)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(cell_type=factor(cell_type, levels=c("Basal Epithelial","Proliferative Basal Epithelial","Suprabasal Epithelial"))) %>%
     dplyr::filter(grepl("Epithelial", cell_type)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!grepl("Terminally", cell_type)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(cell_type)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TP53clone)) %>%
  dplyr::count(cell_type, TP53clone) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(TP53clone) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(total = sum(n),
         proportion = n / total) %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    ci = list(binom.test(n, total, conf.level = 0.95)$conf.int)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    CI_lower = ci[[1]],
    CI_upper = ci[[2]]
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Calculate p-values
wide <- plotdata %>%
  dplyr::select(cell_type, TP53clone, n) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = TP53clone, values_from = n, values_fill = 0
  )
pvalues <- wide %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    total_wt    = sum(`Wildtype`, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_mutant = sum(`Mutant`, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    contingency = list(matrix(
      c(`Wildtype`,            total_wt    - `Wildtype`,
        `Mutant`,         total_mutant - `Mutant`),
      nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE
    )),
    # Use Fisher if any cell <5, else chi-squared
    p.value = {
      m <- contingency
      if (any(rowSums(m) == 0) || any(colSums(m) == 0)) NA_real_ else
        if (any(m < 5)) fisher.test(m)$p.value else chisq.test(m, correct = FALSE)$p.value
    }
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(cell_type, p.value)

# Merge p-values back to plotdata
plotdata <- plotdata %>%
  dplyr::left_join(pvalues, by = "cell_type") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cell_type) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(y_position = max(CI_upper) + 0.05) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(TP53clone=factor(TP53clone, levels=c("Wildtype","Mutant")))


ggplot(plotdata, aes(x = TP53clone, y = proportion, fill = TP53clone)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", width = 0.5) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = CI_lower, ymax = CI_upper),
                width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  facet_grid(. ~ cell_type) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("lightgrey","#7B1FA2","#81C784")) +
  labs(y = "Fraction of cells", x = "", fill = "Cell") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top",
        strip.background = element_blank()) +
  geom_text(aes(x = 1.5, y = y_position,
                label = paste0("p = ", signif(p.value, 3))),
            inherit.aes = FALSE)

#ggsave(paste0(fig_dir, "PhenotypeBias.TP53.pdf"), width = 4, height = 3)
```

```{r plot CNVs along all chromosomes}
get_tip_children <- function(node_id,patient) {
  print(node_id)
    tree_all_info_annotated <- readRDS(paste0(input_figs,"phylogeny.",patient,".RDS"))
      node_data <- tree_all_info_annotated@phylo$node.label
      node_index <- which(node_data == node_id) + length(tree_all_info_annotated@phylo$tip.label)
      # Check the node number
      print(node_index)
      # Extract all descendants (as a subtree)
      subtree_phylo <- ape::extract.clade(tree_all_info_annotated@phylo, node = node_index)
      children=subtree_phylo$tip.label
  output <- cbind(cell=children) %>% as.data.frame %>%
           dplyr::mutate(node=node_id)
  return(output)
}
```      

### Create tree zooms (D)
```{r}

    # Find the node number corresponding to label "N142"
    # cu01 N530  TP53.M246I clone A
    # cu01 N99   chr6amp   clone B
    # cu02 N272  chromotripsis clone C
    # cu03 N121  chr12amp clone D
    # cu08 N172  chr5amp clone E

    patient <- "cu03"
    node_id <- "N121"
    tag_id <- "cloneD"
    tree_all_info_annotated <- readRDS(paste0(input_figs,"phylogeny.",patient,".RDS"))
      node_data <- tree_all_info_annotated@phylo$node.label
      node_index <- which(node_data == node_id) + length(tree_all_info_annotated@phylo$tip.label)
      # Check the node number
      print(node_index)
      # Extract all descendants (as a subtree)
      subtree_phylo <- ape::extract.clade(tree_all_info_annotated@phylo, node = node_index)
      # Find the tip with the maximum depth (in order to keep common mutations to the clone)
      depths <- ape::node.depth.edgelength(tree_all_info_annotated@phylo)
      tip_depths <- depths[1:length(tree_all_info_annotated@phylo$tip.label)]
      farthest_tip_index <- which.max(tip_depths)
      tip_labels <- subtree_phylo$tip.label
      farthest_tip_label <- tip_labels[farthest_tip_index]
      if (patient=="cu01"){
              external_cell <- "cu01_p1r1C10"
      } else if (patient=="cu02"){
          external_cell <- "cu02_p2r3L24"
      } else if (patient=="cu03"){
               external_cell <- "cu03_p2r3I23"
      } else if (patient=="cu08") {
        external_cell <- "cu08_p3r4L20"
      }
      to_keep <- c(farthest_tip_label,external_cell)
      tree_cnloh_zoom <- treeio::drop.tip(tree_all_info_annotated, setdiff(setdiff(tree_all_info_annotated@phylo$tip.label,to_keep),subtree_phylo$tip.label))
      ggtree(tree_cnloh_zoom) + geom_tiplab()


    itol_dir <- paste0(main_dir, "iTol/")
     treeio::write.beast.newick(tree_cnloh_zoom %>%
                                 as_tibble() %>%
                                 dplyr::select(-colnames(tree_cnloh_zoom@data)[grepl("(^_.*_$)|(*rooting*)",colnames(tree_cnloh_zoom@data))]) %>%
                                 dplyr::select(parent, node, `branch.length`, label, 
                                               nmutations_branchlength, bootstrap, 
                                               divtime_0.95_CI, ogaini_mutations,
                                               ogaini_mutations_string, ogaini_mutations_string_collapsed,
                                               nonsynon_mutations_string,synon_mutations_string,dNdS,all_mutations_string,ogaini_87genes,
                                               CI_Lower, 
                                               CI_Upper, mutated_clone_id, Rate,
                                               MinTime,MaxTime) %>%
                                 treeio::as.treedata(), 
                                 file = paste0(itol_dir,patient,".",tag_id,".zoom.tree"))
```    

```{r}
# phylogenetic correction proliferation
  Winv <- PATH::inv_tree_dist(mytree@phylo, norm = FALSE)

  colnames(tp53_status) <- levels(as.factor(all_data$ogaini_mutations_string_collapsed))[1:ncol(tp53_status)]
  cell_cycle_phase <- PATH::catMat(as.numeric(as.factor(all_data$phase)))
  colnames(cell_cycle_phase) <- levels(as.factor(all_data$phase))[1:ncol(cell_cycle_phase)]
  regions <- PATH::catMat(as.numeric(as.factor(all_data$region)))
  colnames(regions) <- paste("Region",levels(as.factor(all_data$region))[1:ncol(regions)])
  cell_cycle_phase_simple <- PATH::catMat(as.numeric(as.factor(gsub("S","G2M",all_data$phase))))
```
