### TP53 clonal age (C)

```{r}


donor_age_database <- fread(paste0(input_figs,"donor.metadata.txt"))

NumCellsNode <- function(mynode, mytree){
  minitree <- treeio::tree_subset(mytree, node = mynode, levels_back = 0)
  num_cells <- length(minitree@phylo$tip.label)
  region <- minitree %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    dplyr::select(region) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(region)) %>%
    unlist() %>% table() %>% names()
  extra_info_clones <- cbind(label=mynode, num_cells=as.numeric(num_cells),region=region[1])
  return(extra_info_clones)
}


ClonalAge <- function(patient){
  
  mytree <- readRDS(paste0(input_figs,"phylogeny.",patient,".RDS")) 
  print(patient)
  # inspect the phylogeny on itol to obtain the node ID
 if (patient=="cu01"){
      # P112A, P112A_CNLOH ,R136H139del, G240V,C199Y, Q97X, M207I, M207I_chr3amp
      tp53_clone_id <- c("N254","N260","N284","N143", "N520","N187","N530","N532")
      #haplotypeB <- c()    
      #  chr9_cnloh_nodes <- c(haplotypeA,haplotypeB) 
      tp53_nodes_table <- cbind(label=tp53_clone_id, tp53_clone_name=c("P112A", "P112A\nchr17pCNLOH", "R136_H139del","G240V","C199Y","Q97X\nchr17pCNLOH","M207I","M207I_amp"))  %>%
        as.data.frame() 
   } else {
    print("Please specify a patient for which CNLOH events have been defined")
    return()
  }

  clone_age <- mytree %>% as_tibble() %>%
    dplyr::filter(label %in% tp53_clone_id) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(tp53_nodes_table) %>%
    dplyr::select(label,branch.length, DivTime, DivTime2, CI_Lower, CI_Upper, divtime_0.95_CI,tp53_clone_name) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(donor=patient) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(donor_age_database %>% dplyr::rename(donor=V1)) 
  
  clone_size <- do.call("rbind",lapply(tp53_clone_id, NumCellsNode, mytree=mytree)) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(label=as.factor(label))  %>%
  dplyr::mutate(region=as.character(region))
  
  clone_age2 <- clone_age %>%
    dplyr::full_join(clone_size,by = "label")

  return(clone_age2)
}


TP53_ClonalAges <- do.call("rbind",lapply(X = c("cu01"),ClonalAge))
      
TP53_ClonalAges_annotated <- TP53_ClonalAges %>%
  dplyr::filter(donor==patient) %>%
  mutate(label = reorder(label, DivTime))


TP53_ClonalAges_annotated %>%

ggplot(aes(x=tp53_clone_name)) +
```

```{r}
        library(GenomicRanges)

        # Create GRanges for defined intervals
        defined_intervals <- AI_merged_phased_chr[,1:3]
        ref_gr <- GRanges(seqnames = defined_intervals$CHR,
                          ranges = IRanges(start = defined_intervals$START, end = defined_intervals$END))
        patient_vaf_assignment_gr <- GRanges(seqnames = patient_vaf_assignment$chr,
                         ranges = IRanges(start = patient_vaf_assignment$start, end = patient_vaf_assignment$end),
                         state = patient_vaf_assignment$state,
                         cell = patient_vaf_assignment$cell)
        
        # For each cell, find overlaps with the reference intervals and assign state
        get_cell_states <- function(cell_id) {
          cell_gr <- patient_vaf_assignment_gr[mcols(patient_vaf_assignment_gr)$cell == cell_id]
          overlaps <- findOverlaps(ref_gr, cell_gr)
          
          # Start with NA for all intervals
          states <- rep(NA_integer_, length(ref_gr))
          states[queryHits(overlaps)] <- mcols(cell_gr)$state[subjectHits(overlaps)]
          
          tibble(cell = cell_id,
                 segment = paste0(seqnames(ref_gr), ":", start(ref_gr), "-", end(ref_gr)),
                 state = states)
        }
        # Apply to all cells
        all_cells <- unique(patient_vaf_assignment_gr$cell)
        patient_vaf_assignment_allcells <- purrr::map_dfr(all_cells, get_cell_states)
        # Pivot to matrix
        phased_state_matrix <- patient_vaf_assignment_allcells %>%
          pivot_wider(names_from = segment, values_from = state) %>%
          arrange(cell) %>% tibble::column_to_rownames("cell")  %>% data.matrix() %>% t()

  # assign each LOH a major allele after segmentation
      compute_haplotype <- function(cell) {
        biased_segs <- names(which(phased_state_matrix[, cell] == 2))
        if (length(biased_segs) == 0) return(NA_character_)
        
        mystart <- as.numeric(gsub("-.*", "", gsub(".*:", "", biased_segs[1])))
        myend <- as.numeric(gsub(".*-", "", gsub(".*:", "", biased_segs[length(biased_segs)])))
        
        myvafs <- matrix_input %>%
          as.data.frame() %>%
          tibble::rownames_to_column("id") %>%
          mutate(start = as.numeric(gsub("-.*", "", gsub(".*:", "", id))),
                 end = as.numeric(gsub(".*-", "", gsub(".*:", "", id)))) %>%
          filter(start >= mystart & end <= myend) %>%
          pull(cell) %>%
          as.numeric()
        
        if (length(myvafs) == 0 || all(is.na(myvafs))) return(NA_character_)
        
        d <- density(myvafs, na.rm = TRUE)
        area_below <- sum(d$y[d$x < 0.5]) * mean(diff(d$x), na.rm=T)
        area_above <- sum(d$y[d$x > 0.5]) * mean(diff(d$x), na.rm=T)
        
        if (area_below > area_above) "A" else "B"
      }
      
      # Get haplotype assignment for each cell
      haplotype_per_cell <- setNames(vapply(colnames(phased_state_matrix), compute_haplotype, character(1)), 
                                     colnames(phased_state_matrix))
      # Build character matrix
      phased_state_matrix_AB <- matrix(NA_character_, nrow = nrow(phased_state_matrix), ncol = ncol(phased_state_matrix),
                                       dimnames = dimnames(phased_state_matrix))

    for (cell in colnames(phased_state_matrix)) {
      hap <- haplotype_per_cell[[cell]]
      states <- phased_state_matrix[, cell]
      new_states <- rep(NA_character_, length(states))
      new_states[states == 1] <- "A/B"
      new_states[states == 2] <- hap
      phased_state_matrix_AB[, cell] <- new_states
    }

    state_levels <- c("A/B", "A", "B")
    state_colors <- c("darkblue", "#F7BA00", "#8ADEF6")
    
    # Replace the LOH present just in one cell by A/B
    phased_state_matrix_AB_backup <- phased_state_matrix_AB
    phased_state_matrix_AB_singleton <- phased_state_matrix_AB  # make a copy to modify
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(phased_state_matrix_AB))) {
      row_vals <- phased_state_matrix_AB[i, ]
      uniq_vals <- unique(na.omit(row_vals))
      
      for (val in uniq_vals) {
        if (sum(row_vals == val, na.rm = TRUE) == 1) {
          phased_state_matrix_AB_singleton[i, row_vals == val] <- "A/B"
        }
      }
    }
    
    phased_state_matrix_AB <- phased_state_matrix_AB_singleton
    
    
    # Map to numeric codes
    encoded_matrix <- matrix(NA_integer_, nrow = nrow(phased_state_matrix_AB), ncol = ncol(phased_state_matrix_AB),
                             dimnames = dimnames(phased_state_matrix_AB))
    encoded_matrix[phased_state_matrix_AB == "A/B"] <- 1
    encoded_matrix[phased_state_matrix_AB == "A"] <- 2
    encoded_matrix[phased_state_matrix_AB == "B"] <- 3
    
    col_fun_main <- colorRamp2(c(1, 2, 3), state_colors)
#    pdf(file = paste0(fig_dir, "ComplexHeatmap.chr9.",patient,".phased.",mybinsize,".hmm.pdf"), width = 15, height = 10)
```

```{r }
        rdr_common_rows_df <- merge(rdr_anno, final_dt2, by = c("START", "END"), all = FALSE)
        # Clean column names by removing suffixes .x and .y
        colnames(rdr_common_rows_df) <- gsub("\\.x$|\\.y$", "", colnames(rdr_common_rows_df))
        colnames(final_dt2) <- gsub("\\.x$|\\.y$", "", colnames(final_dt2))
        # Identify numeric columns in both tables (excluding keys)
        num_cols_rdr <- setdiff(names(rdr_anno), c("START", "END", "CHR"))
        num_cols_final <- setdiff(names(final_dt2), c("START", "END", "CHR"))
        common_num_cols <- intersect(num_cols_rdr, num_cols_final)
        # Subset merged dataframe and final_dt2 to common numeric columns
        rdr_common_numeric <- rdr_common_rows_df[, ..common_num_cols]
        final_dt_numeric <- final_dt2[, ..common_num_cols]
        # Convert to numeric matrices
        rdr_common_num_mat <- as.matrix(sapply(rdr_common_numeric, as.numeric))
        final_dt_num_mat <- as.matrix(sapply(final_dt_numeric, as.numeric))

        # replace CNV values for the longest LOH in chr9q for cells with no LOH
        start_9q <- which(final_dt2$START==as.numeric(gsub(",","",collapsed_df_curated$start[1])))
        end_9q <- which(final_dt2$END==as.numeric(gsub(",","",collapsed_df_curated$end[nrow(collapsed_df_curated)])))
        nonLOH_cells <- colSums(final_dt2[,c(-1,-2,-3)]) == nrow(final_dt2)
        LOH_cells <- colSums(final_dt2[,c(-1,-2,-3)]) != nrow(final_dt2)
        sum(nonLOH_cells)+sum(LOH_cells)
        
        # Get the numeric parts of final_dt2, excluding CHR/START/END
       final_num_dt <- final_dt2[, -(1:3), with = FALSE]
        common_cells <- intersect(colnames(final_dt_num_mat),colnames(rdr_common_num_mat))
        
        rdr_common_num_mat <- rdr_common_num_mat[,common_cells]
        noncnloh_CNV_matrix_9q_simple <- rdr_common_num_mat[start_9q:end_9q,intersect(colnames(rdr_common_num_mat),names(nonLOH_cells[nonLOH_cells]))]
        dim(noncnloh_CNV_matrix_9q_simple)
        CNV_noncnloh<- matrixStats::colMedians(noncnloh_CNV_matrix_9q_simple, na.rm = T) %>% cbind()  

      # Subset both matrices to common cells
      final_mask_mat <- as.matrix(final_num_dt[, ..common_cells])
      rdr_to_mask <- rdr_common_num_mat[, common_cells]
      rdr_to_mask[final_mask_mat == 0] <- NA
      rdr_to_mask[final_mask_mat == 1] <- NA
      # Put masked data back in full matrix
      rdr_common_num_mat[, common_cells] <- rdr_to_mask
        
        CNV_cnloh <- matrixStats::colMedians(rdr_common_num_mat[,names(LOH_cells[LOH_cells])], na.rm = T) %>% cbind() 

        colnames(CNV_cnloh) <- "median CNV\n in LOH" 
      
        rdr_simplified_anno2 <- rbind(CNV_cnloh,CNV_noncnloh) %>% as.data.frame() %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("label") %>%
          dplyr::left_join(mytree %>%
          as_tibble() %>%
          dplyr::select(label, MAD) %>% dplyr::filter(!grepl("^N",label))) %>%
          dplyr::mutate(median=`median CNV\n in LOH`) %>%
          dplyr::rowwise() %>%
          dplyr::mutate(`median CNV\n in LOH`=ifelse(MAD>0.2,NA,`median CNV\n in LOH`))

        
        col_fun_cnv = circlize::colorRamp2(c(0,1,2,3,max(rdr_simplified_anno2$median, na.rm = T)), c("darkred","tomato","darkseagreen","violet","darkviolet"))

        # Define the unique CNV values you want to assign discrete colors to
        discrete_cnv_values <- min(unique(rdr_simplified_anno2$median), na.rm = T):max(unique(rdr_simplified_anno2$`median`), na.rm = T)
        # Get corresponding HEX codes for each value
        cnv_hex_colors <- setNames(col_fun_cnv(discrete_cnv_values), discrete_cnv_values)
        # correlation rdr and MAD score
        rdr_simplified_anno2 %>%
          dplyr::select(- `median CNV\n in LOH`) %>% 
          dplyr::mutate(label=gsub("\\..*","",label)) %>%
          arrange(label) %>%
          ggplot(aes(as.factor(median),MAD, fill=as.factor(median))) +
          geom_jitter(col="black") +
                  geom_boxplot(alpha=0.8) +
          scale_fill_manual(values = c(as.vector(cnv_hex_colors), "black")) +
          theme_classic() +
          theme(legend.position = "top") +
          geom_hline(yintercept = 0.2, linetype=2) +
          labs(x="Median estimated copy number\tat LOH event",
               y="Coverage MAD score",fill="Copy number")
      ggsave(paste0(fig_dir, "MAD.LOHCN.",patient,".pdf"), height = 6, width = 6)
        
    
      
        rdr_simplified_anno3 <- cbind(label=colnames(final_dt[,c(-1,-2,-3)])) %>% as.data.frame() %>%
          left_join(rdr_simplified_anno2) %>%
          dplyr::select(`median CNV\n in LOH`) %>% unlist()
        table(rdr_simplified_anno3)
        length(rdr_simplified_anno3)
```

```{r}
donor_age_database <- fread(paste0(input_figs,"donor.metadata.txt"))

NumCellsNode <- function(mynode, mytree){
  minitree <- treeio::tree_subset(mytree, node = mynode, levels_back = 0)
  num_cells <- length(minitree@phylo$tip.label)
  region <- minitree %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    dplyr::select(region) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(region)) %>%
    unlist() %>% table() %>% names()
  extra_info_clones <- cbind(label=mynode, num_cells=as.numeric(num_cells),region=region[1])
  return(extra_info_clones)
}


ClonalAge <- function(patient){
  
  mytree <- readRDS(paste0(input_figs,"/phylogeny.",patient,".RDS")) 

  # most ancestral node for CNLOH

  print(patient)
  # inspect the phylogeny by eye to obtain the node ID
  if (patient=="eso29"){
    # I need to create from itol
    mylink <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vTRE5hP8_2xk3TceUsJsiRZl9ZIXtdGC0oozMsXhHttU5_bJdgzoTN1M7VjIqrluLf4TOx-m-XcIlps/pub?gid=382810351&single=true&output=tsv"

  } else if (patient=="cu01"){
   #  mylink <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vTRE5hP8_2xk3TceUsJsiRZl9ZIXtdGC0oozMsXhHttU5_bJdgzoTN1M7VjIqrluLf4TOx-m-XcIlps/pub?gid=642594400&single=true&output=tsv" # before phasing
    mylink <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vTRE5hP8_2xk3TceUsJsiRZl9ZIXtdGC0oozMsXhHttU5_bJdgzoTN1M7VjIqrluLf4TOx-m-XcIlps/pub?gid=1615473351&single=true&output=tsv"

  } else if (patient=="cu02"){
    
     mylink <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vTRE5hP8_2xk3TceUsJsiRZl9ZIXtdGC0oozMsXhHttU5_bJdgzoTN1M7VjIqrluLf4TOx-m-XcIlps/pub?gid=292177913&single=true&output=tsv"
    
  } else if (patient=="cu03") {
    
   mylink <-  "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vTRE5hP8_2xk3TceUsJsiRZl9ZIXtdGC0oozMsXhHttU5_bJdgzoTN1M7VjIqrluLf4TOx-m-XcIlps/pub?gid=595230679&single=true&output=tsv"
  
  } else if (patient=="cu08"){
     mylink <-  "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vTRE5hP8_2xk3TceUsJsiRZl9ZIXtdGC0oozMsXhHttU5_bJdgzoTN1M7VjIqrluLf4TOx-m-XcIlps/pub?gid=370351366&single=true&output=tsv"
  } else {
    print("Please specify a patient for which CNLOH events have been defined")
    return()
  }

        haplotypes <- data.table::fread(mylink, header = T) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(Node_cloneID=ifelse(grepl("^p",Node_cloneID),
                                          paste0(patient, "_",Node_cloneID),
                                          Node_cloneID))  %>%
        dplyr::select(Node_cloneID, Haplotype) %>%
        dplyr::filter(grepl("^N",Node_cloneID)) %>%
        unique() 
      haplotypeA <- haplotypes %>%
        dplyr::filter(Haplotype=="A") %>%
        dplyr::select(Node_cloneID) %>%
        unlist() %>% 
        as.character()
      haplotypeB <- haplotypes %>%
        dplyr::filter(Haplotype=="B") %>%
        dplyr::select(Node_cloneID) %>%
        unlist() %>% 
        as.character()    
        chr9_cnloh_nodes <- c(haplotypeA,haplotypeB) 
  
  clone_age <- mytree %>% as_tibble() %>%
    dplyr::filter(label %in% chr9_cnloh_nodes) %>%
    dplyr::select(label,branch.length, DivTime, CI_Lower, CI_Upper, divtime_0.95_CI) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(donor=patient) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(haplotype=ifelse(label %in% haplotypeA, "A","B")) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(donor_age_database %>% dplyr::rename(donor=V1)) 
  
  clone_size <- do.call("rbind",lapply(chr9_cnloh_nodes, NumCellsNode, mytree=mytree)) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(label=as.factor(label))  %>%
  dplyr::mutate(region=as.character(region))
  
  clone_age2 <- clone_age %>%
    dplyr::full_join(clone_size,by = "label")

  return(clone_age2)
}
```

### Effect on mutation rate on phylogenetic accuracy using simulated data from the invitro tree (C)

We used CellCoal to simulate a different number of mutations using the in vitro tree as user tree. The we reconstructed the tree from the somatic mutations with Cellphy. 

```{bash}

cd ${RESDIR}cellcoal

# Append parameters to the template
sim="sim.invitro.decreasingnumbermutations"
mkdir $sim
sampled_cells=16 # s: number of cells sampled
number_sites=1000000 # l: number of sites, max 1 million
number_fixed_mutations=500 # j: fixed number of mutations ISM

cat ${INPUT_FIGS}parameters_template_invitro | \
  sed "s/\ss$/\ss${sampled_cells}/" | \
  sed "s/results$/results${number_fixed_mutations}/" | \
  sed "s/l$/l${number_sites}/" |\
  sed "s/T$/TInvitro_days.nwk/" |\
  sed "s/j$/j${number_fixed_mutations}/" > ${sim}/parameters${number_fixed_mutations}
cp custom_input_tree/Invitro_days_divisionunits.nwk ${sim}

cd $sim
cellcoal-1.1.0 -Fparameters${number_fixed_mutations}

cd results${number_fixed_mutations}

module load bcftools
tail -n +3  vcf | bgzip -c > somatic.vcf.gz
tabix -p vcf somatic.vcf.gz
module load bcftools
# Remove non-shared mutations (non phylogenetically informative)
bcftools view -s ^healthycell somatic.vcf.gz -O z > somatic.filtered.vcf.gz

git clone https://github.com/jzinno/cloudCellphy.git
cd cloudCellphy
    bin/raxml-ng-cellphy-linux \
        --search \
        --msa ../somatic.filtered.vcf.gz \
        --model GT10+FO+E \
        --msa-format VCF \
        --threads 1 \
        --prob-msa on 

```

```{r}

EvaluationTrees <- function(muts){
  
  print(as.character(muts))

    true_tree <- ape::read.tree(paste0(main_dir,"../Simulations/cellcoal/custom_input_tree/Invitro_days_divisionunits.nwk"))
    
    estimated_tree <- ape::read.tree(paste0(main_dir,"../Simulations/cellcoal/sim.invitro.decreasingnumbermutations/results",muts,"/somatic.filtered.vcf.gz.raxml.bestTree"))
      
    
    # Read header
    vcf_header <- data.table::fread(
      paste0(main_dir,"../Simulations/cellcoal/sim.invitro.decreasingnumbermutations/results",muts,"/vcf"), 
      skip = "#CHROM", 
      nrows = 0
    )
    
    vcf_samples <- colnames(vcf_header)[10:(ncol(vcf_header)-1)]
    original_labels <- true_tree$tip.label
    # diccionary mapping cellcoal tips and ground truth
    # order in the VCF matches the order in the tree object
    name_map <- data.frame(
      original = original_labels,
      vcf_name = vcf_samples,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    
    estimated_tree$tip.label <- name_map$original[match(estimated_tree$tip.label, name_map$vcf_name)]
    
    sq_status <- Quartet::QuartetStatus(true_tree,estimated_tree)
    quartet_out <- Quartet::SimilarityMetrics(sq_status)
    similarity <- as.numeric(quartet_out[1,"QuartetDivergence"])
    similarity
    
    true_splits <- ape::prop.part(true_tree)
    est_splits <- ape::prop.part(estimated_tree)
    true_unrooted <- ape::unroot(true_tree)
    est_unrooted  <- ape::unroot(estimated_tree)
    # count matches
    comparison <- ape::comparePhylo(true_unrooted, est_unrooted, plot = FALSE)
    
    myresult <- cbind(accuracy=similarity, node_recovery=sub(" .*", "",comparison$messages[7]), id=muts)
  return(myresult)

}


benchmark <- do.call("rbind",lapply(X = list("5","50","500","5000","50000","500000"), FUN = EvaluationTrees))

# max sites to simulate with´cellcoal is 1M
genome_size_sequenceable <- 3.1e9*0.85 # effective 15x genome size

true_tree <- ape::read.tree(paste0(main_dir,"../Simulations/cellcoal/custom_input_tree/Invitro_days_divisionunits.nwk"))
divisions <- sum(true_tree$edge.length)
divisions

# This gives you the height of the tree (e.g., ~14 units)
experiment_duration <- max(ape::node.depth.edgelength(true_tree))

benchmark %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(node_recovery=gsub("No",0, node_recovery)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(calculated_mu = as.numeric(id) / (genome_size_sequenceable * divisions)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = as.numeric(calculated_mu))) +
    geom_line(aes(y = as.numeric(accuracy), group = 1),color = "black", size = 1) +
    geom_point(aes(y = as.numeric(accuracy)),color = "black", size = 3) +
    labs(x = "Mutation rate",y="Phylogenetic accuracy\n(fraction identical quartets)", fill = NULL, color = NULL) +
    theme_classic() +
  annotate("rect", 
           xmin = 5e-10, xmax = 1e-9, 
           ymin = 0, ymax = 1, 
           alpha = 0.2, fill = "gold1") + 
  ylim(0,1) +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "log10") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1.6*10^-8, col="tomato", linetype=2) +
  annotate("text", 
           x = 1*10^-8,          
           y = 0.5,            
           label = "DLD-1\nμ",
           hjust = 0,           
           color = "tomato") +
  annotate("text", 
           x = 5*10^-10,          
           y = 0.5,            
           label = "healthy\nμ",
           hjust = 0,           
           color = "gold1") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.33, linetype=2, col="lightgrey")
```

### Trinucleotide context profile of SNVs classified as FPs by the linked-read analysis (A)

```{r }

Obtain_fp_tp_profile <- function(patient){
 
        lr <- fread(paste0(main_dir,patient,
                           "/manual_collate/sequoia/fpr/linked-reads-annotations.bed"))
  # this is only to add information about REF and ALT alleles which are not present in the BED file
  tab <- fread(paste0(main_dir,patient,"/manual_collate/sequoia/myselectedvars.snvswithsingletons.4round3burden.table"),
               select = c("CHROM", "POS", "REF", "ALT"))
  
  lr[tab, on = c(chrom = "CHROM", end = "POS"),
     `:=`(REF = i.REF, ALT = i.ALT)]
  
  linked_read_tpfp <- lr %>%
  dplyr::filter(LR_class_stringent %in% c("tp","fp"))
 linked_read_tpfp[, trinuc_context := as.character(
      getSeq(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38::BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38, names = chrom, start = end - 1, end = end + 1)
    )]
    linked_read_tpfp[, is_purine := REF %in% c("A", "G")]
    linked_read_tpfp[is_purine == TRUE, `:=`(
      trinuc_context = as.character(reverseComplement(DNAStringSet(trinuc_context))),
      REF = as.character(complement(DNAStringSet(REF))),
      ALT = as.character(complement(DNAStringSet(ALT)))
    )]
    linked_read_tpfp[, mut_type := paste0(substr(trinuc_context, 1, 1), "[", REF, ">", ALT, "]", substr(trinuc_context, 3, 3))]
    
    bases <- c("A","C","G","T")
    subs  <- c("C>A","C>G","C>T","T>A","T>C","T>G")
    context96 <- as.vector(sapply(subs, function(s) {
      paste0(rep(bases, each = 4), "[", s, "]", rep(bases, times = 4))
    }))
    linked_read_tpfp[, mut_type := factor(mut_type, levels = context96)]
    linked_read_tp <- linked_read_tpfp %>% dplyr::filter(LR_class_stringent=="tp")
    linked_read_fp <- linked_read_tpfp %>% dplyr::filter(LR_class_stringent=="fp")
    counts_96_tp <- table(linked_read_tp$mut_type)
    counts_96_fp <- table(linked_read_fp$mut_type)

   out <- cbind(context96) %>%
     as.data.frame() %>%
     dplyr::left_join(cbind(counts_96_tp) %>% as.data.frame() %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("context96")) %>%
     dplyr::left_join(cbind(counts_96_fp) %>% as.data.frame() %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("context96")) %>%
     tibble::column_to_rownames("context96") %>%
     t() %>%
     as.data.frame() %>%
     dplyr::mutate(donor=patient) %>%
     tibble::rownames_to_column("type")

  }

fp_tp_profile_alldonors <- do.call("rbind",lapply(X=c("cu03","cu08","eso29","cu01","cu02"),Obtain_fp_tp_profile)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(bioskryb=ifelse(donor=="cu08", "v2","v1")) 
#saveRDS(fp_tp_profile_alldonors, paste0(input_figs,"96trinucleotides_linked-reads.rds"))

fp_tp_profile_alldonors_reference <- fp_tp_profile_alldonors %>%
  dplyr::mutate(type2=paste0(gsub("counts_96_","",type), "_",donor, ".",bioskryb)) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("type2") %>%
  dplyr::select(-type, -donor, -bioskryb) %>%
  t() 


fp_v1_cols <- grep("^fp_.*\\.v1$", colnames(fp_tp_profile_alldonors_reference), value = TRUE)
fp_v2_cols <- grep("^fp_.*\\.v2$", colnames(fp_tp_profile_alldonors_reference), value = TRUE)

plot_data <- cbind(FP.v1,FP.v2) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("trinuc") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(change = gsub("\\].*", "", gsub(".*\\[", "", trinuc))) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c( "FP.v1","FP.v2")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(name) %>%
  dplyr::filter(name=="FP.v1") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(total = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()
label_data <- plot_data %>%
  dplyr::distinct(name, total) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(change = "C>A")  
ggplot(plot_data, aes(trinuc, value, fill = change)) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_grid(. ~ change, scales = "free") +
  ggsci::scale_fill_cosmic(palette = "signature_substitutions") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, size = 7, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
        strip.background = element_blank()) +
  labs(x="Trinucleotide",y="Counts")
```

```{r}
crosscorr_calc <- function(tree){

    W <- one_node_tree_dist(tree)
  
  phenotypes_metadata <- readRDS(paste0(main_dir, "cu01", "/results/phenotypes_rna_raw.rds"))
  states <- cbind(cell=tree$tip.label) %>% as.data.frame() %>%
    dplyr::left_join(phenotypes_metadata %>%
    dplyr::select(`sample name`, celltype, region) %>%
    dplyr::rename(cell=`sample name`))
  
  # choose celltype or region
  #X <- catMat(states$celltype)
  X <- catMat(states$region)

  phy1xcor <- xcor(X, W) 
  return(phy1xcor)
}

xcor_phylip <- crosscorr_calc(tree=phylip)
xcor_stdcellphy <- crosscorr_calc(tree=standard_cellphy)

cbind(auto=diag(xcor_phylip$phy_cor), pval=diag(xcor_phylip$one.sided.pvalue)) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(method="Phylip mix") %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("region") %>%
  rbind(cbind(auto=diag(xcor_stdcellphy$phy_cor), pval=diag(xcor_stdcellphy$one.sided.pvalue)) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(method="CellPhy")   %>% 
    tibble::rownames_to_column("region")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(method=factor(method, levels=c("Phylip mix","CellPhy"))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(stat=ifelse(pval<0.05, "significant", "not significant")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(region, auto)) +
  geom_col(width=0.5, aes(fill=method), position = "dodge") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("pink","mediumpurple1")) +
  labs(x="Esophageal regions",y="Phylogenetic correlation (Moran\'s I)", fill="", alpha="")
```

```{r}
# Bayesian calibration
bayesian_calibration <- readRDS(paste0(input_figs, "TimeTree_TreeMut_NullModel_eso01_benchmark.RDS"))
bayesian_calibration$tip.label <- gsub("eso29_","",bayesian_calibration$tip.label)
phenotypes_rna_and_variablemarkers <- readRDS(paste0(main_dir,"eso29/results/phenotypes_rna_raw.rds"))
bayesian_calibration_annotated <- dplyr::left_join(as_tibble(bayesian_calibration),
                          phenotypes_rna_and_variablemarkers %>%
                            dplyr::mutate(`sample name`=gsub("eso29_","",`sample name`)) %>%
                          dplyr::rename(label=`sample name`) %>%
                          dplyr::filter(!is.na(label)), by = 'label') %>%
                          treeio::as.treedata()
bayesian_calibration_annotated <- treeio::drop.tip(bayesian_calibration_annotated,"zeros")
bayesian_calibration_annotated_p1 <- ggtree(bayesian_calibration_annotated) +
  geom_tiplab(size=3) +
  geom_tippoint(aes(col=celltype)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("tomato","skyblue")) +
  labs(title="treefit null model, strict clock\n(bayesian, > 1h30min)") +
  theme_tree2() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.75, linetype=2) +
  scale_x_continuous("Time", limits = c(0, max(nodeHeights(bayesian_calibration_annotated@phylo))+10))


# we constrained the age of the root by specifying a calibration 
# on the MRCA between the designated outgroup (zeros) 
# and one ingroup taxon. This ensured that the total length of the tree was fixed 
# to the desired absolute time (79+9 months units) 
megacc_out <- paste0(main_dir, "eso29/manual_collate/sequoia/classifier/mutmapping/maxIt.100/megacc_input_eso29simple/output/")
reltime_calibration <- readRDS(paste0(megacc_out, "TimeTree.reltime.eso29simple.rds"))

length(reltime_calibration@phylo$tip.label)

reltime_calibration_annotated <- dplyr::left_join(as_tibble(reltime_calibration),
                          phenotypes_rna_and_variablemarkers %>%
                            dplyr::mutate(`sample name`=gsub("eso29_","",`sample name`)) %>%
                          dplyr::rename(label=`sample name`) %>%
                          dplyr::filter(!is.na(label)), by = 'label') %>%
                          treeio::as.treedata()
reltime_p1 <- ggtree(reltime_calibration_annotated) +
  geom_tiplab(size=3) +
  geom_tippoint(aes(col=celltype)) +
  geom_range( range='divtime_0.95_CI', color="pink", size = 2, alpha = 0.5, linetype=1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("tomato","skyblue")) +
  theme_tree2() +
  labs(title="RelTime, relaxed clock\n(non bayesian, < 1sec)") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.75, linetype=2) +
  scale_x_continuous("Time", limits = c(0, max(nodeHeights(reltime_calibration_annotated@phylo))+10))


(bayesian_calibration_annotated_p1 | reltime_p1) + plot_layout(nrow = 2)
```

```{r}
       dplyr::mutate(id=paste0(CHROM,":",POS,"_",REF,">",ALT)) %>%
       dplyr::filter(id %in% early_somatic) %>%
       dplyr::select(c(id,colnames(myvars)[grepl("\\.AD$",colnames(myvars))]))
    
# remove VAF of cells with low coverage at that position
myearly_somatic_fortree2[myearly_somatic_coverage[,2:ncol(myearly_somatic_coverage)] < 2] <- NA
rownames(myearly_somatic_fortree2) <- gsub(".*_","",rownames(myearly_somatic_fortree2))
 
# Downsample only to the nodes of interest
     itol_multipleregions <- c("N551","N345")
     node_data <- mytree@phylo$node.label
     Getlabels <- function(clone_id){
            print(paste0("Clone: ",clone_id))
            node_index <- which(node_data == clone_id) + length(mytree@phylo$tip.label)
      # Check the node number
      print(node_index)
      # Extract all descendants (as a subtree)
      subtree_phylo <- ape::extract.clade(mytree@phylo, node = node_index)
      # Find the tip with the maximum depth (in order to keep common mutations to the clone)
      tips_to_keep <- subtree_phylo$tip.label
      return(tips_to_keep)  
     }
    tips_to_keep <- c(as.vector(unlist(sapply(itol_multipleregions,Getlabels))))
     tips_to_drop <- setdiff( mytree@phylo$tip.label, tips_to_keep)
     mytree_small <- treeio::drop.tip(mytree, tips_to_drop)

mytree_small <- mytree_small %>% treeio::as_tibble() %>% dplyr::mutate(label=gsub(".*_","",label)) %>% treeio::as.treedata()
```

### Cross-correlation of cell states (B)
```{r}


state_phylocor <- function(patient){
  mytree <- readRDS(paste0(input_figs, "/phylogeny.",patient,".RDS"))


  # use topology (node distance) instead of branch length to avoid circularity (immune-epi divergence is used for calibration)
  Winv <- PATH::one_node_tree_dist(mytree@phylo, norm = FALSE)

  # select the phenotypic information of the tips  
  all_data <-  mytree@data
  all_data <- all_data[1:length(mytree@phylo$tip.label),colnames(all_data)]

  all_data <- all_data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(replicate=ifelse(is.na(replicate),substr(gsub(".*_","",label2),4,4), replicate)) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(row=ifelse(is.na(row),substr(gsub(".*_","",label2),5,5), row)) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(col=ifelse(is.na(col),substr(gsub(".*_","",label2),5,nchar(label2)), col)) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(pct_counts_ribo=ifelse(is.na(pct_counts_ribo),0, pct_counts_ribo)) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(pct_counts_mt=ifelse(is.na(pct_counts_mt),0, pct_counts_mt)) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(total_counts=ifelse(is.na(total_counts),0, total_counts)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(celltype=as.factor(celltype))

  celltypes_discrete <- PATH::catMat(as.numeric(all_data$celltype)) 
  colnames(celltypes_discrete) <- levels(all_data$celltype)[1:ncol(celltypes_discrete)]
  
  
  celltypes_discrete2 <- cbind(celltypes_discrete)
  xcor_celltypes <- PATH::xcor(data = celltypes_discrete2, 
                      weight.matrix = Winv) 
  
  
  # Create barplot for the heatmap
  # transform into presabs
  celltypes_discrete2_presabs <- celltypes_discrete2
  celltypes_discrete2_presabs[celltypes_discrete2>0] <- 1
  col_counts <- log(colSums(celltypes_discrete2_presabs))
  bar_colors <- c("lightgrey")
  # Create column annotation
  ha <- ComplexHeatmap::HeatmapAnnotation(
    "Number of cells\n(log scale)" = ComplexHeatmap::anno_barplot(col_counts,gp = gpar(fill = bar_colors, col=bar_colors), border = FALSE,
                                      axis_param = list(at = log(c(10, 100, 1000)), # Log scale positions on the axis
                                      labels = c("10", "100", "1000")) # Log scale axis
)
  )
  
    # Create a mapping of cell types to colors
    cell_type_colors <- c("CD45+" = "tomato", "EPCAM+" = "skyblue")
    # Create row annotation for cell types
    row_ha <- rowAnnotation(
      "Cell type" = anno_simple(colnames(celltypes_discrete2), col = cell_type_colors)
    )
    ha_celltypes <- HeatmapAnnotation(
      "Cell type" = anno_simple(colnames(celltypes_discrete2), col = cell_type_colors)
    )
    
  # Convert p-values to significance symbols
  symbol_pvaluematrix <- apply(xcor_celltypes$one.sided.pvalue, c(1, 2), 
                         function(p) {
                           if (p < 0.001) {
                             return("***")
                             } else if (p < 0.01) {
                               return("**")
                               } else if (p < 0.05) {
                                 return("*")
                                 } else {
                                   return("ns") # No symbol for p >= 0.05
                                   }})

  col_fun = circlize::colorRamp2(c(min(as.vector(xcor_celltypes$Z.score)),0,max(as.vector(xcor_celltypes$Z.score))), 
                       c("brown2", "white", "darkblue"))
  pdf(paste0(fig_dir, "Crosscorrelation.",patient,".pdf"), width = 8, height = 6)
  ht <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(xcor_celltypes$Z.score, name="Phylogenetic correlation\n(Z score)",
                          show_column_dend = F, 
                          cluster_rows = F, cluster_columns = F,
                          show_row_dend = F, 
                          right_annotation = row_ha,
                          bottom_annotation = ha_celltypes,
                          col=col_fun,
                          heatmap_legend_param = list(
                                 legend_direction = "vertical"),
                            # Add p-value symbols on top of the heatmap as annotations
                            cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
                                     grid.text(symbol_pvaluematrix[i, j], x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, col = "black"))
                            }
                          )
  draw(ht, heatmap_legend_side = "right")
  dev.off()
}

lapply(X = c("cu01","cu03","cu08"),state_phylocor)
  
```



### LTT for immune and epithelial (D)

```{r}
 

ltttable <- function(donor,myregion){
      
    tree <- readRDS(paste0(input_figs, "phylogeny.",donor,".RDS"))
    
      regionsdiscard <- tree %>% as_tibble() %>% 
        dplyr::select(label,region) %>% 
            dplyr::filter(region!=myregion) %>%
            dplyr::select(label) %>% unlist()
      tree.region <- treeio::drop.tip(tree, tip = regionsdiscard)
      immune <- tree.region %>% as_tibble() %>% 
        dplyr::select(label,celltype) %>% 
            dplyr::filter(celltype=="CD45+") %>%
            dplyr::select(label) %>% unlist()
      epi <- tree.region %>% as_tibble() %>% 
        dplyr::select(label,celltype) %>% 
            dplyr::filter(celltype=="EPCAM+") %>%
            dplyr::select(label) %>% unlist()
      if (length(immune)<=2){
        immune.ltt2 <- NULL
      } else{
        immune.tree <- treeio::drop.tip(tree.region, tip = epi)
        print(paste0("Remaining cells:",length(immune.tree@phylo$tip.label)))
        ltt.immune <- ape::ltt.plot.coords(immune.tree@phylo, backward = FALSE)
        immune.ltt2 <- data.frame(time = ltt.immune[,1], 
                                lineages = ltt.immune[,2], 
                                cell_type = "CD45+",
                                region=myregion)
      }

      if (length(epi)<=2){
        epi.ltt2 <- NULL
      } else {
        epi.tree <- treeio::drop.tip(tree.region, tip = immune)
            print(paste0("Remaining cells:",length(epi.tree@phylo$tip.label)))
        ltt.epi <- ape::ltt.plot.coords(epi.tree@phylo, backward = FALSE)
        epi.ltt2 <- data.frame(time = ltt.epi[,1], 
                               lineages = ltt.epi[,2], 
                               cell_type = "EPCAM+", 
                               region=myregion)
      } 
      mytable <- rbind(immune.ltt2,epi.ltt2) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(donor=donor)
      return(mytable)  
}

lttsbyregion1 <- do.call("rbind",lapply(c("1"),ltttable, donor="eso29"))
lttsbyregion2 <- do.call("rbind",lapply(c("A","B","C","D"),ltttable, donor="cu01"))
lttsbyregion3 <- do.call("rbind",lapply(c("1","2","3","4"),ltttable, donor="cu02"))
lttsbyregion4 <- do.call("rbind",lapply(c("A","B","C","D"),ltttable, donor="cu03"))
lttsbyregion5 <- do.call("rbind",lapply(c("A","B","C"),ltttable, donor="cu08"))


rbind(lttsbyregion1,lttsbyregion2,lttsbyregion4, lttsbyregion5) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(mygroup=paste0(donor,"_",region,"_",cell_type)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(donor, region, cell_type) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(total=dplyr::n()) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(prop=lineages/total) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(donor=gsub("cu08","eso05",gsub("cu03","eso04",gsub("cu02","eso03",gsub("cu01","eso02",gsub("eso29", "eso01",donor)))))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(time, prop, col=donor)) +
  geom_line(aes(group=mygroup,color=cell_type, linetype=cell_type),size=0.5) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("tomato", "skyblue")) +
  facet_grid(. ~ donor) +
  labs(x="Time (years)", y="Proportion ofLineages", linetype="Cell type",fill="Cell type", col="Cell type") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",  strip.background = element_blank()) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(), shape = guide_legend())

 ggsave(paste0(fig_dir, "ImmuneEpiLTT.perregion.r3.pdf"), width = 5.5, height = 3.5)
```

```{r}
# Load esophagus trees and create cuts and normalize the age
donor <- "cu01"

donor <- "cu02"

donor <- "cu08"

# Download from https://github.com/emily-mitchell/normal_haematopoiesis/blob/main/11_LOY_simulations/input/
# considered young in the publication
# KX001 (29yo). male
# KX002 (38yo). male
# AX001 (63yo). male
# considered old in the publication
# KX003 (81yo) male
# KX008 (76yo) female
# KX004 (77yo) female
young_blood <- ape::read.tree(file="Downloads/KX002_ultra.tree")
young_blood_2 <- ape::read.tree(file="Downloads/AX001_ultra.tree")
young_blood_3 <- ape::read.tree(file="Downloads/KX001_ultra.tree")
old_blood <- ape::read.tree(file="Downloads/KX003_ultra.tree")


# All trees were rescaled to a root-to-tip depth of 1 (the blood phylogenies were
# already on this scale) and downsampled to a common number of tips, so that
# phylogenetic diversity reflects branching shape in relative time rather than
# accumulated time or the number of cells sampled
eso_old <- eso_old@phylo
current_depth <- max(ape::node.depth.edgelength(eso_old))
eso_old$edge.length <- eso_old$edge.length / current_depth
eso_young <- phytools::treeSlice(eso_old, 30/79, orientation="rootwards")
current_depth <- max(ape::node.depth.edgelength(eso_young))
eso_young$edge.length <- eso_young$edge.length / current_depth
eso_old_2 <- eso_old_2@phylo
current_depth <- max(ape::node.depth.edgelength(eso_old_2))
eso_old_2$edge.length <- eso_old_2$edge.length / current_depth
eso_young_2 <- phytools::treeSlice(eso_old_2, 30/76, orientation="rootwards")
current_depth <- max(ape::node.depth.edgelength(eso_young_2))
eso_young_2$edge.length <- eso_young_2$edge.length / current_depth
eso_old_3 <- eso_old_3@phylo
current_depth <- max(ape::node.depth.edgelength(eso_old_3))
eso_old_3$edge.length <- eso_old_3$edge.length / current_depth
eso_young_3 <- phytools::treeSlice(eso_old_3, 30/77, orientation="rootwards")
current_depth <- max(ape::node.depth.edgelength(eso_young_3))
eso_young_3$edge.length <- eso_young_3$edge.length / current_depth
eso_old_4 <- eso_old_4@phylo
current_depth <- max(ape::node.depth.edgelength(eso_old_4))
eso_old_4$edge.length <- eso_old_4$edge.length / current_depth
eso_young_4 <- phytools::treeSlice(eso_old_4, 30/63, orientation="rootwards")
current_depth <- max(ape::node.depth.edgelength(eso_young_4))
eso_young_4$edge.length <- eso_young_4$edge.length / current_depth

young_blood_estimated <- phytools::treeSlice(old_blood, 30/81, orientation="rootwards")
current_depth <- max(ape::node.depth.edgelength(young_blood_estimated))
young_blood_estimated$edge.length <- young_blood_estimated$edge.length / current_depth

# Downsampling
desired_tipsize <- min(length(eso_young$tip.label),length(eso_young_2$tip.label),
                       length(eso_young_3$tip.label),length(eso_young_4$tip.label),
                       length(young_blood_estimated$tip.label))

downsamplingtree <- function(tree, desired_tipsize=100){
  tips_present_downsampled <- sample(tree$tip.label,length(tree$tip.label)-desired_tipsize)
  tree <- treeio::drop.tip(tree, tips_present_downsampled)
  return(tree)
}


# Create a named list of the objects
trees_to_process <- list(
  old_blood_ds=old_blood, young_blood_ds=young_blood, young_blood_2_ds=young_blood_2, young_blood_3_ds=young_blood_3,
  young_blood_estimated_ds=young_blood_estimated,
  eso_old_ds=eso_old, eso_old_2_ds=eso_old_2, eso_old_3_ds=eso_old_3, eso_old_4_ds=eso_old_4, eso_young_ds=eso_young, 
  eso_young_2_ds=eso_young_2, eso_young_3_ds=eso_young_3, eso_young_4_ds=eso_young_4)
# Run the downsampling
processed_list <- lapply(trees_to_process, downsamplingtree, desired_tipsize=desired_tipsize)
# Overwrite the object trees
list2env(processed_list, envir = .GlobalEnv)

  dplyr::mutate(tissue=ifelse(grepl("blood",name), "blood", ifelse(grepl("eso",name),"esophagus",name))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(numeric_age=case_when(name=="eso_old_4" ~ "63",
                                      name=="eso_old_3" ~ "77",
                                      name=="eso_old_2" ~ "76",
                                      name=="eso_old" ~ "79",
                                      name=="old_blood" ~ "81",
                                      name=="young_blood" ~ "38",
                                      name=="young_blood_2" ~ "63",
                                      name=="young_blood_3" ~ "29",
                                      TRUE ~ "30")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Age=ifelse(numeric_age>=75,">=75 yo","<65 yo")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!grepl("(estimated|eso_young)",name)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Age, tissue) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(mean_div=mean(value), mean_sd=sd(value)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(type=ifelse(grepl("(estimated|eso_young)",name), "estimate (30yo)", "empirical (different ages)")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(Age, y=mean_div)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(), aes(fill=tissue)) +
  geom_point(aes(y=value,col=type), size=2 ) +
  # Add the error bars
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_div - mean_sd, ymax = mean_div + mean_sd),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(y=value, label=numeric_age), size=5, col="brown") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("tomato","skyblue")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("brown","gold1")) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(y="Gamma statistic",x="",col="") +
  facet_grid(. ~ tissue) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1), strip.background = element_blank())
```

```{r}
patient="cu01"

obtain_cumulative_signature <- function(patient) {
    input.sigs <- data.table::fread(paste0(
    input_figs,
    "signatures/", patient,
    "_halves_with40/Assignment_Solution/Activities/Assignment_Solution_Activities.txt"
  ))

  signature_contribution <- t(input.sigs[,-1])
  colnames(signature_contribution) <- input.sigs$Samples
  
  signature_contribution <- signature_contribution %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(total = rowSums(.)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(total > 0) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Signature") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = input.sigs$Samples) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    name = forcats::fct_recode(
      name,
      Early  = "Not_Recent",
      Middle = "Recent",
      Late   = "Terminal"
    ),
    name = forcats::fct_relevel(name, "Early", "Middle", "Late")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Signature) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(name, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(value_cum = cumsum(value)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(donor=patient)
 return(signature_contribution) 
  
}
```

### Node age distribution (C)

```{r}


BranchTimeClassification <- function(patient){

  print(patient)
    mytree <- readRDS(paste0(input_figs, "/phylogeny.",patient,".RDS")) 
    
    donor_age_database <- paste0(input_figs,"donor.metadata.txt")
    donor_age <- data.table::fread(donor_age_database) %>%
      dplyr::filter(V1==patient) %>%
      dplyr::select(V2) %>% as.numeric()
    
    immune <-  read.table (file =  paste0(input_figs,"/immune.",patient,".txt")) %>% 
      unlist() %>% as.vector()
    
    mytree_epi<- treeio::drop.tip(mytree, immune)
    length(mytree_epi@phylo$tip.label)
    
    mytree_epi %>% as_tibble() %>%
        dplyr::select(label,branch.length, DivTime, nmutations_branchlength, 
                      DivTime2, CI_Lower, CI_Upper, divtime_0.95_CI) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(donor=patient) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(DonorAge=donor_age + 0.75) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(class=ifelse(grepl("(^cu|^eso)",label),
                                   "terminal",ifelse(DivTime<=40, 
                                                     "internal (adulthood)","internal (early)"))) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(DivTimeForward=(donor_age+0.75)-DivTime) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(DivTimeForward=ifelse(grepl("(^cu|^eso)",label), 
                                          donor_age+0.75,DivTimeForward)) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(DivTimeStart=DivTimeForward-branch.length) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(MiddleTime=DivTimeForward-((DivTimeForward-DivTimeStart)/2)) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(donor=gsub("cu08","eso05",gsub("cu03","eso04",gsub("cu02","eso03",gsub("cu01","eso02",gsub("eso29", "eso01",donor)))))) 

}

BranchTimeClassificationAll <- do.call("rbind",lapply(X = c("eso29","cu01","cu02","cu03","cu08"),BranchTimeClassification))


stage_colors <- c(
```

### Coverage along non-overlapping windows for NOTCH1/2 (E, F)


```{r}

library(rtracklayer)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(Biostrings)
library(GenomicRanges)


  patient <- "eso29"
  gene <- "NOTCH1"
  gtf.gr = rtracklayer::import.gff(con = 
                                     paste0(RESDIR,
                                            "/dna_mutations/Inigo.Yokoyama.combined.fullpanel.gtf"), 
                                   format = 'gtf')  

  CoverageBedgraph <- function(patient,gene,bin.size=100){  


     print(gene)
    
      gene.region = data.frame(
      Gene = c("NOTCH2","NOTCH1",
               "TP53","NOTCH3"),
      Region = c("chr1:119,911,553-120,100,779","chr9:136,494,433-136,546,048",
                 "chr17:7,661,779-7,687,538","chr19:15,159,038-15,200,995")
    ) %>%
      dplyr::filter(Gene==gene) %>%
      dplyr::select(Region) %>%
      unlist()
    
    track.folder <- paste0(main_dir,patient,"/results/Coverage")       # folder with your .bw files
  chr   <- sub(":.*", "", gene.region)
  coords <- gsub(",", "", sub(".*:", "", gene.region))
  start <- as.numeric(sub("-.*", "", coords))
  end   <- as.numeric(sub(".*-", "", coords))
  
  bw.files <- list.files(track.folder, pattern=paste0(gene,"\\.bw$"), full.names = TRUE)
  
  track.list <- lapply(bw.files, function(bw_file){
    
      # Import coverage for region
      cov <- import(bw_file, which=GRanges(seqnames=chr, ranges=IRanges(start=start,end=end)))
      
      # Create fixed bins
      bins <- tile(IRanges(start=start, end=end), width=bin.size)
      bins <- unlist(bins)
      bins <- GRanges(seqnames=chr, ranges=bins)
      
      # Overlap coverage with bins
      hits <- findOverlaps(bins, cov)
      
      # Compute average coverage per bin
      avg_cov <- tapply(cov$score[subjectHits(hits)], queryHits(hits), mean)
      bins$score <- avg_cov
      
      # Convert to data.frame for LoadTrackFile (bedGraph-like)
      df <- data.frame(
        chr = as.character(seqnames(bins)),
        start = start(bins) - 1,  # bedGraph format is 0-based
        end = end(bins),
        score = bins$score
      )
      
      df
    })

    # Create the bedgraphs from the bigwig 
    tracks.df <- purrr::map2_dfr(track.list, basename(bw.files), ~ mutate(.x, Sample = .y))
    temp.dir <- file.path(track.folder, "bedgraph_for_tracks")
    dir.create(temp.dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
    dir.create(paste0(temp.dir,"/",gene), showWarnings = FALSE)

    for(i in seq_along(track.list)){
      out.file <- file.path(temp.dir,gene,"/", paste0(gsub(".bw","",basename(bw.files[i])), ".bedgraph"))
      write.table(track.list[[i]], file=out.file, quote=FALSE, sep="\t",
                  row.names=FALSE, col.names=FALSE)
    }

    # folder with the bigwig files
    myfolder <- paste0(main_dir,patient,"/results/Coverage/bedgraph_for_tracks/",gene,"/")
    # list file in dir
    mysamples <- gsub(".bedgraph","",list.files(myfolder, pattern = gene))
    
    # create metadata
    if (patient=="eso29"){
      gsheet_link <- c("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vTRE5hP8_2xk3TceUsJsiRZl9ZIXtdGC0oozMsXhHttU5_bJdgzoTN1M7VjIqrluLf4TOx-m-XcIlps/pub?gid=313557387&single=true&output=tsv")
     } else {
      print("publish the link")
    }
    sample.meta <- fread(gsheet_link) %>%
      dplyr::select(`sample name`,`cell type`) %>%
      dplyr::filter(`sample name`!="") %>%
      dplyr::mutate(`cell type`=gsub("\\+","",ifelse(`cell type`=="", "EpCAM+",`cell type`))) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(`cell type`) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(id = row_number()) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(Type=paste0(`cell type`," ",id)) %>%
      dplyr::rename(SampleName=`sample name`,Group=`cell type`) %>%
      dplyr::select(SampleName,Type,Group) %>% as.data.frame() %>%
      dplyr::mutate(SampleName=gsub("$",paste0(".",gene),SampleName)) %>%
      dplyr::filter(SampleName %in% mysamples) %>% head(7)
        
    
    gene.region = data.frame(
      Gene = c("NOTCH2","NOTCH1",
               "TP53","NOTCH3"),
      Region = c("chr1:119,911,553-120,100,779","chr9:136,494,433-136,546,048",
                 "chr17:7,661,779-7,687,538","chr19:15,159,038-15,200,995")
    ) %>%
      dplyr::filter(Gene==gene) %>%
      dplyr::select(Region) %>%
      unlist()
    
    print(gene.region)
      track.df <- ggcoverage::LoadTrackFile(track.folder = myfolder,
                                format = "bedgraph",
                                extend=0,
                                gtf.gr = NULL,
                                meta.info = sample.meta,
                                region=gene.region,
                                norm.method = "None",
                                bin.size = bin.size)

    
    
    mycols_mod <- c("skyblue","tomato")

    
   basic.coverage <-  ggplot() +
      ggcoverage::geom_coverage(data = track.df, mark.region = NULL, facet.color = "white") +
      ggcoverage::theme_coverage() +
      ggcoverage::geom_gc(bs.fa.seq = BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38::BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38, ) +
            scale_fill_manual(values=rev(mycols_mod)) +
           ggcoverage::geom_gene(gtf.gr=gtf.gr) +
      ggcoverage::geom_ideogram(genome = "hg38") +
      theme(strip.text.x = element_text(size=3))
    
    basic.coverage
    ggsave(filename = paste0(fig_dir, "Coverage.",patient,".",gene,".pdf"), height = 8, width = 12)

 }
```

```{r}
# Creating a branch mapping string for singletons
# Create a vector with strings specifying the position of the cell
CreateDictionaryBranch <- function(donor){
      cell_order <- scan(paste0(input_figs,"PhylogenyMappingTipOrder.",donor,".txt"),what = character())
      myvars <- fread(paste0(input_figs,"myselectedvars.snvswithsingletons.classifierfiltered.nocontaminatedcells.treemut.",donor,".table"),nrows = 2, header = T,sep = "\t")
    cell_vcf <- gsub(".VAF","",colnames(myvars)[grepl(paste0(donor,".*",".VAF$"),colnames(myvars))])
    length(cell_vcf)
    # Create arrays 
      indices <- c(1:length(cell_order))
      # Create a matrix of zeros
      n <- length(indices)
      max_index <- max(indices)
      result <- matrix(0, nrow = n, ncol = max_index)
      # Assign 1 at the specified positions
      result[cbind(1:n, indices)] <- 1
      # I think the arrays have a zero at the beginning
      string_array <- apply(result, 1, paste0, collapse = "")
      sub_dict <- setNames(string_array, cell_order)
      return(sub_dict)
}

  CreateDictionaryBranch("eso29"),
  CreateDictionaryBranch("cu01"),
  CreateDictionaryBranch("cu02"),
  CreateDictionaryBranch("cu03"),
```

```{r}
    patient <- "cu01"
    tree_all_info_annotated <- readRDS(paste0(input_figs,"/phylogeny.",patient,".RDS"))
    
    # multiple mutant clone N228 (itol) is interesting
    # Find the node number corresponding to label "N288"
      node_data <- tree_all_info_annotated@phylo$node.label
      node_index <- which(node_data == "N228") + length(tree_all_info_annotated@phylo$tip.label)
      # Extract all descendants (as a subtree)
      subtree_phylo <- ape::extract.clade(tree_all_info_annotated@phylo, node = node_index)
      # Find the tip with the maximum depth (in order to keep clonal mutations)
      depths <- ape::node.depth.edgelength(tree_all_info_annotated@phylo)
      tip_depths <- depths[1:length(tree_all_info_annotated@phylo$tip.label)]
      farthest_tip_index <- which.max(tip_depths)
      tip_labels <- subtree_phylo$tip.label
      farthest_tip_label <- tip_labels[farthest_tip_index]
      external_cell <- "cu01_p1r1C10"
      to_keep <- c(farthest_tip_label,external_cell)
      tree_just_fat1 <- treeio::drop.tip(tree_all_info_annotated, setdiff(setdiff(tree_all_info_annotated@phylo$tip.label,to_keep),subtree_phylo$tip.label))
      ggtree(tree_just_fat1) + geom_tiplab()


    # directory to save the files to
    itol_dir <- paste0(main_dir,"iTol/")
     treeio::write.beast.newick(tree_just_fat1 %>%
                                 as_tibble() %>%
```       

```{r}
donors <- unique(AllMutationsInGenes$donor)
        
  decode_dicts <- lapply(donors, function(patient) {
          
          # read cell order
          cell_order <- scan(paste0(input_figs,
                                    "PhylogenyMappingTipOrder.",patient,".txt"),
                             what = character())
          
          # read VCF table to get singletons
          table_snvs <- paste0(input_figs, "myselectedvars.snvswithsingletons.classifierfiltered.nocontaminatedcells.treemut.",patient,".table")
          
          # build dictionary for singletons
          indices <- seq_along(cell_order)
          n <- length(indices)
          print(n)
          max_index <- max(indices)
          result <- matrix(0, nrow = n, ncol = max_index)
          result[cbind(1:n, indices)] <- 1
          string_array <- apply(result, 1, paste0, collapse = "")
          sub_dict <- setNames(string_array, cell_order)
          
          # build decode dictionary for branches
          branch_patterns <- unique(c(cell_order, AllMutationsInGenes$branch0[AllMutationsInGenes$donor==patient],
                                      AllMutationsInGenes$branch[AllMutationsInGenes$donor==patient]))
          
          decode_branch <- function(bin_str, cell_order) {
            bits <- strsplit(bin_str, "")[[1]]
            cells_present <- cell_order[which(bits == "1")]
            paste(cells_present, collapse = ",")
          }
          
          decoded_dict <- setNames(sapply(branch_patterns, decode_branch, cell_order = cell_order), branch_patterns)
          
          list(patient = patient,
               sub_dict = sub_dict,
               decoded_dict = decoded_dict,
               cell_order = cell_order)
        })
        
        names(decode_dicts) <- donors

# CALCULATE DNDS FOR ALL THE MUTATIONS AND PER GENE #
SelectionPerDonor <- function(donor){
  
  print(donor)
  dndsout <- dndscv(mutations %>%
                      dplyr::filter(sampleID==donor) %>%
                          dplyr::filter(pos != lag(as.numeric(pos)) + 1 | is.na(lag(as.numeric(pos)))) %>% # remove second mutation if consecutive mutations (avoid dinucleotide)
                        dplyr::mutate(chr=gsub("chr","",chr)),
                        gene_list=c("TP53","FAT1","TTN"),
                        max_coding_muts_per_sample=1000000, # increase to include all mutations
                        max_muts_per_gene_per_sample=1000, # increase to include all genes
                        outmats=TRUE,
                        refdb=RefCDS,
                        cv=covs)
  dndsout$globaldnds
  dndsout$nbreg$theta
  ci = geneci(dndsout,
              gene_list = c("TP53","FAT1","TTN")) 


  myoutput=list(global=dndsout$globaldnds %>% dplyr::mutate(donor=donor),
                theta=cbind(theta=dndsout$nbreg$theta,donor=donor) %>% as.data.frame(),
                pergene_withcovariates=dndsout$sel_cv %>% dplyr::mutate(donor=donor),
                pergene_nocovariates=dndsout$sel_loc %>% dplyr::mutate(donor=donor),
                exclud_mutations=exclmuts_df <- if (is.null(dndsout$exclmuts)) {
                  tibble(chr = character(),
                         pos = integer(),
                         ref = character(),
                         mut = character(),
                         sampleID = character(),
                         donor = character())
                } else {
                  dndsout$exclmuts %>% mutate(donor = donor)
                },
                ci=ci %>% dplyr::mutate(donor=donor))
  return(myoutput)
    
}

dnds_allpatients <- lapply(X = c("cu01","cu02","cu03"),SelectionPerDonor)

theta_all <- do.call("rbind",lapply(dnds_allpatients, `[[`, 2))

    dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene_type_strict)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(mis_mle,tru_mle), names_to = "type_a",values_to="mle") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(mis_high,tru_high), names_to = "type_b",values_to="cihigh") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(mis_low,tru_low), names_to = "type_c",values_to="cilow") %>%
    dplyr::filter((type_a=="mis_mle" & type_b=="mis_high" & type_c=="mis_low") | (type_a=="tru_mle" & type_b=="tru_high" & type_c=="tru_low")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(type=gsub("tru_mle","truncating",gsub("mis_mle","missense",type_a))) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(gene_type_strict=factor(as.factor(gene_type_strict),levels=c("Negative control","PNE"))) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(gene=factor(as.factor(gene),levels=c("TTN","TP53","FAT1"))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(donor,mle)) +
```

```{r}
  colnames(gene_expression) <- gsub("_","",colnames(gene_expression))
  # Check which columns have all zeros (or dots) by checking column sums
  non_zero_columns <- colSums(gene_expression != 0) > 0  
 # Subset the matrix to keep only non-zero columns
 gene_expression_nonmissing <- gene_expression[, non_zero_columns]

  tp53_status2 <- cbind(tp53_status,
                               as.matrix(gene_expression_nonmissing)
                        )
  xcor_tp53 <- PATH::xcor(data = tp53_status2, 
                      weight.matrix = Winv)

row_anno_CNV <- rowAnnotation(

bin_cnv <- matrix_gene_overlap %>%
  dplyr::select(seqnames, start, end) %>%
  plyranges::as_granges() %>%
  plyranges::join_overlap_left(gr3) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(CNV_ID = tidyr::replace_na(CNV_ID, "0"))

CNV_region <- matrix_gene_overlap %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(gene_cols)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(CNV_ID = bin_cnv$CNV_ID) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(dplyr::all_of(gene_cols)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(value == "1", CNV_ID != "0") %>%
  dplyr::distinct(name, CNV_ID) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(name) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(CNV = paste(sort(unique(CNV_ID)), collapse = "/"), .groups = "drop")

region_id <- tibble::tibble(name = gene_cols) %>%

                         "C" = "blue",

  # Convert p-values to significance symbols
  symbol_pvaluematrix <- apply(xcor_tp53$one.sided.pvalue, c(1, 2), 
                         function(p) {
                           if (p < 0.001) {
                             return("*\n*\n*")
                             } else if (p < 0.01) {
                               return("*\n*")
                               } else if (p < 0.05) {
                                 return("*")
                                 } else {
                                   return("") # No symbol for p >= 0.05
                                   }})

    col_fun = circlize::colorRamp2(c(min(as.vector(xcor_tp53$Z.score)),0,max(as.vector(xcor_tp53$Z.score))), 
                       c("darkblue", "white", "brown2"))
  
pdf(paste0(fig_dir, "Crosscorrelation.",patient,".TP53.genes.pdf"), width = 12, height = 4)
    ht <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
                         xcor_tp53$Z.score, 
                         name="Phylogenetic correlation\n(Z score)",
                          show_column_dend = F, 
                           column_names_gp    = gpar(fontsize = 7),
                          cluster_rows = T, 
                         cluster_columns = F,
                          show_row_dend = F, 
                          col=col_fun,
                         top_annotation = ha_cnv,
                         cluster_column_slices = FALSE,
                          column_split = region_id$CNV,  # or a factor if you have predefined clusters
                            # Add p-value symbols on top of the heatmap as annotations
                            cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
                                     grid.text(symbol_pvaluematrix[i, j], x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 3, col = "black"))
                            }
                          )
  draw(ht,
       heatmap_legend_side = "right")
 
dev.off()
```

```{r}
                      dplyr::mutate(start = as.integer(start) - (5 * 50000)) %>%
                      dplyr::mutate(end = as.integer(end) + (5 * 50000))
    gene <- "NOTCH1"
    # generate annotations for the gene/region of interest
     gene_table <- AI_merged_phased_chr[which(notnoisyrows),1:3] %>% 
                      as.data.frame() %>%
                      dplyr::mutate(gene = dplyr::case_when(
                              START > gene_regions[which(genes[,1]=="PTCH1"),"start"] &
                                END < gene_regions[which(genes[,1]=="PTCH1"),"end"] ~ 1,
                              START > gene_regions[which(genes[,1]==gene),"start"] &
                                END < gene_regions[which(genes[,1]==gene),"end"] ~ 1,
                            .default=0))
  
      combined_row_anno <- ComplexHeatmap::rowAnnotation(
        "chromosome\nband" = band_info$gieStain,
          "genes" = gene_table$gene,
          show_legend = FALSE,
          show_annotation_name = FALSE,
          col = list(
            genes = c("0" = "white", "1" = "seagreen"),
            "chromosome\nband" = c(
              "gneg"    = "white",
              "gpos25"  = "gray85",
              "gpos50"  = "gray65",
              "gpos75"  = "gray45",
              "gpos100" = "black",
              "gvar"    = "gray90",
              "stalk"   = "brown3",
              "acen"    = "red"
            )
          ),
          annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12),
          border = TRUE
        )

      
   
      
col_fun_main = colorRamp2(c(0, 0.5,1), c("#F7BA00","darkblue", "#8ADEF6"))
pdf(file = paste0(fig_dir, "ComplexHeatmap.",chrom,".",patient,".phased.",mybinsize,".pdf"), width = 20, height = 10)
```

```{r}
HeatmapCNLOHEarly <- function(mydonor) {

                        dplyr::rename(cell_names="DEFINE FIELDS →") %>%

     dplyr::ungroup()

  somatic_snvs=paste0(input_figs, "/myselectedvars.snvswithsingletons.classifierfiltered.nocontaminatedcells.treemut.",mydonor,".table")
      command=paste0('awk -v mychr=^',mychr,' \'{if ($1 ~ mychr || $1 ~ \"^CHROM\"){print $0}}\' ',somatic_snvs,' | awk -v mystart=',mystart,' \'{if ($2 >= mystart){print $0}}\' ') 
      somatic_chr9_vcf <- data.table::fread(command,data.table=F, check.names = F)

      
     # Peak count function
      count_peaks <- function(x) {
        dens <- density(x)
        y <- dens$y
        peaks <- which(diff(sign(diff(y))) == -2) + 1
        length(peaks)
      }
      
   variant_matrix_1 <- somatic_chr9_vcf %>% 
     dplyr::select(gsub("$",".VAF",CNLOH_cells)) %>%
        dplyr::mutate_all(as.numeric) %>%
  dplyr::filter(rowSums(., na.rm = TRUE) > 0) %>%
  dplyr::filter(apply(., 1, max, na.rm = TRUE) > 0.9) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
mutate(peaks = count_peaks(na.omit(c_across(everything())))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
#  filter(peaks > 1) %>%  # keep only bimodal rows
  select(-peaks)  
   
     cell_names <- gsub(".VAF","",colnames(variant_matrix_1)[grepl("\\.VAF$", colnames(variant_matrix_1))])
   
   cnloh_cell_states <- cell_names %>% cbind() %>%
     as.data.frame() %>%

     dplyr::left_join(cnloh_node_info %>% dplyr::rename(cell_names=cell_name)) %>%
     dplyr::mutate(type=ifelse(is.na(Node_cloneID), "Singletons",Node_cloneID)) 

   colnames(variant_matrix_1) <- gsub(".VAF","",colnames(variant_matrix_1))
   
     mytree=readRDS(paste0(input_figs, "phylogeny.",mydonor,".RDS"))
    myggtree <- ggtree(mytree) +
      geom_tiplab(size=2)
    taxa_in_tree_order<- get_taxa_name(myggtree)
   
col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(0, 0.9, 1),
  c("aliceblue", "turquoise","darkblue")
)
    
   Heatmap(variant_matrix_1,
           name="B-allele\nfrequency",
           cluster_rows = T,
          col = col_fun,
          show_row_dend = F,
           column_split = cnloh_cell_states$type,
          column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 0),
          column_title_rot = 90,
          column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7),
           column_order = intersect(colnames(variant_matrix_1),taxa_in_tree_order))

}
```

```{r}
# Prepare data + Clopper–Pearson CI with binom.test
plotdata <- burden_highres %>% dplyr::rename(cell_name = cell) %>%
  left_join(chr9cnloh_combined %>%
              dplyr::select(cell_name,haplotype) %>%
              unique() %>%
              dplyr::group_by(cell_name) %>%
              dplyr::summarise(haplotype=max(as.numeric(haplotype))) %>%
              dplyr::ungroup()) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(CNLOHclone = ifelse(haplotype == 1, "Wildtype (AB)", "CNLOH (AA or BB)"),
         CNLOHclone = factor(CNLOHclone, levels = c("Wildtype (AB)","CNLOH (AA or BB)"))) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(phenotypes_rna_raw_all %>% dplyr::rename(cell_name=`sample name`) %>% dplyr::select(cell_name,phase)) %>%
  filter(grepl("^Basal Epithelial$", cell_type)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(cell_type)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(phase)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(phase=ifelse(phase=="G2M","S/G2M",phase)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(phase=ifelse(phase=="S","S/G2M",phase)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(phase=factor(phase, levels=c("G1","S/G2M"))) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(CNLOHclone)) %>%
  dplyr::count(phase, CNLOHclone) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CNLOHclone) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(total = sum(n),
         proportion = n / total) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    ci = list(binom.test(n, total, conf.level = 0.95)$conf.int)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    CI_lower = ci[[1]],
    CI_upper = ci[[2]]
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Calculate per-cell-type p-values using chi-squared or Fisher test
wide <- plotdata %>%
  dplyr::select(phase, CNLOHclone, n) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = CNLOHclone, values_from = n, values_fill = 0
  )
pvalues <- wide %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    total_wt    = sum(`Wildtype (AB)`, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_cnloh = sum(`CNLOH (AA or BB)`, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    contingency = list(matrix(
      c(`Wildtype (AB)`,            total_wt    - `Wildtype (AB)`,
        `CNLOH (AA or BB)`,         total_cnloh - `CNLOH (AA or BB)`),
      nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE
    )),
    # Use Fisher if any cell <5, else chi-squared
    p.value = {
      m <- contingency
      if (any(rowSums(m) == 0) || any(colSums(m) == 0)) NA_real_ else
        if (any(m < 5)) fisher.test(m)$p.value else chisq.test(m, correct = FALSE)$p.value
    }
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(phase, p.value)

contingency <- wide %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%              # convert tibble → data.frame
  tibble::column_to_rownames("phase") %>%  # use 'phase' column as rownames
  as.matrix()

# It is better to have a single pvalue probably
chisq.test(contingency , correct = FALSE)$p.value


# Merge p-values back to plotdata
plotdata <- plotdata %>%
  left_join(pvalues, by = "phase") %>%
  group_by(phase) %>%
  mutate(y_position = max(CI_upper) + 0.05) %>%
  ungroup()


ggplot(plotdata, aes(x = CNLOHclone, y = proportion, fill = CNLOHclone)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", width = 0.5) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = CI_lower, ymax = CI_upper),
                width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  facet_grid(. ~ phase) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("darkblue","#C1CC7B")) +
  labs(y = "Fraction of cells", x = "", fill = "chr9q") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top",
        strip.background = element_blank()) +
  geom_text(aes(x = 1.5, y = y_position,
                label = paste0("p = ", signif(p.value, 3))),
            inherit.aes = FALSE)

  ggsave(paste(fig_dir,"PhaseBias.CNLOH.basal.r3.pdf",sep=""), dpi = 300, width = 6, height = 6)  
    

```

```{r}
  # Pivot to wide format
  tidyr::pivot_wider(

    names_from = wider_region,
```
